Abstract: Voice provides a natural and immediate interface for AI agents. Many settings in which voice agents could be useful, including meetings, households, and collaborative work, are inherently multi-speaker. Supporting these settings introduces challenges that are largely absent from one-on-one interaction. We introduce the Multi-Speaker Interaction Benchmark (MSI-Bench) for evaluating multi-speaker voice interaction. Each test case is a short multi-party multi-turn audio scene with participant context, expected tool calls, and atomic rubrics. The benchmark targets three capability families: multi-speaker memory, multi-speaker instruction following, and multi-speaker reasoning. It comprises 1,152 test cases, evenly split between Mandarin Chinese and English (576 each). The strongest configuration on each split passes all rubrics on only 66.8% of English and 54.5% of Mandarin cases, and the strongest open-weight configuration on 34.0% and 19.3%. Failure analysis separates perception from reasoning: open-weight models are bottlenecked by the multi-speaker audio front-end, while frontier systems still fail speaker-scoped decision making on clean transcripts---and models across the board often respond when no one has addressed them. These results identify speaker-grounded perception, speaker-scoped decision making, and conversational restraint as concrete targets for future voice agents.

</details>


### [387] [The Answer-Basin Representation Hypothesis: We Are Not Probing or Steering Concepts](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.24821)
*Manjiang Yu,Hongji Li,Zihan Wang,Junwei Chen,Xue Li,Priyanka Singh,Yang Cao,Lijie Hu*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 提出"答案盆地表示假说"，认为模型续写分布在答案上的概率测度组织概念相关的线性结构，其统计量沿跨问题共享的线性方向表示。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 线性表示假说将高维概念与语言模型中的方向关联，但这些概念相关线性结构在模型内部如何组织仍不清楚。

Method: 将产生同一答案的所有续写定义为"答案盆地"，其质量为总概率；这些盆地质量构成答案上的推前概率测度，并假设概念相关线性结构源于答案测度的差异而非概念标签变化。

Result: 在多种模型和任务上，探针与引导中概念一致效应及其反转被关联到概念标签与答案测度之间的对齐程度。

Conclusion: 概念相关线性结构由答案测度组织，而非由概念标签直接决定。

Abstract: The Linear Representation Hypothesis associates high-level concepts with directions in language models, but it remains unclear how these concept-related linear structures are organized within the model. We propose the Answer-Basin Representation Hypothesis: the probability measure induced over answers by the model's continuation distribution organizes these linear structures, with its statistics represented along linear directions shared across questions. All continuations yielding the same answer form an answer basin, whose mass is their total probability. These basin masses define the pushforward probability measure over answers. We posit that concept-related linear structure emerges from differences in the answer measure rather than being determined by changes in concept labels. Experiments across models and tasks link concept-consistent effects and their reversals in probing and steering to the alignment between concept labels and the answer measure.

</details>


### [388] [Decomposing Error and Style in Automated Clinical Coding](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.24877)
*Han-Chin Shing,Jack Moriarty,Ryan Ware,Afton Marchbanks,Carlyn Canvasser,Stefanie Higgins,Harsh Gupta,Fang Wang,Joseph Paul Cohen*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 论文指出临床编码中单一金标准评估把编码风格差异误判为模型错误，提出用10维风格变量ψ建模，条件化后大幅提升ICD编码F1。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 临床编码标签空间达数万，现有评估仅对单一金标注，将任何偏离视为错误。但实测两个团队对同一笔记仅73%一致（审计后77%），该差距可能并非纯错误，而是系统性风格差异。

Method: 将系统性成分建模为编码风格ψ（对"编什么、记多详细"的编码者/站点策略），把编码重构为p(code|note,ψ)，用10维评分量表估计ψ。

Result: 若风格是噪声则条件化无效，但实际在五个数据集上，风格匹配使ICD F1最高提升26点，极端不匹配则最多下降21点；四种提示编码方法（39-49 F1）在提供风格后收敛至52-56（均p<0.05）。

Conclusion: 单一金标准评估中被归为模型误差的很大部分是可恢复的、未建模的风格因素。

Abstract: In automated clinical coding, where the label space spans tens of thousands of diagnosis and procedure codes, models are currently evaluated against a single gold annotation, treating any deviation as error. But we find when two teams code the same 110 ACI-Bench encounters, they agree on only 73% of codes (Jaccard similarity) for the same note; even after an independent clinical audit removes erroneous codes, agreement rises only to 77%. Is that gap error or something systematic? We model the systematic component as coding style $ψ$, a coder- or site-specific policy over what to code and how much to document, and recast coding as $p(\mathrm{code}\mid\mathrm{note},ψ)$, estimating $ψ$ with a 10-dimension rubric. If style were noise, conditioning on it would do nothing. Instead, across five datasets a model conditioned with a data-matching style raises ICD F1 by up to 26 points and an extreme mismatched one lowers it by up to 21. Four prompt based coding methods spanning 39-49 F1 converge to 52-56 once style is supplied (All p<0.05). Much of what single-gold evaluation charges to model error is recoverable, unmodeled style.

</details>


### [389] [The Copy Ceiling: An Input-Exposure Control for Ontology-Grounded Generation over Curated Corpora](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.24885)
*John J. O'Hare*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 论文提出"exposure accounting"（暴露核算）方法，用于区分基于图检索的语料问答评测中，模型是真正在检索结构上推理，还是仅因上下文已包含金标准答案而"抄写"。引入copy ceiling作为无判断基线，发现所有模型相对抄写的增益均为负。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 基于图检索的语料问答中，大的grounding提升不能证明模型对检索结构进行了推理——上下文可能已直接暴露金标准答案。需要一个无需判断者的基线来区分"暴露项的抄写"与"超越暴露的恢复"，从而判断评测有效性。

Method: 提出exposure accounting：将每个金标准项按上下文是否暴露、答案是否恢复分类；以copy ceiling（逐字复制上下文可达到的召回）为标量参照，计算相对抄写的有符号增益。在10个模型、1,136个目标实例、11,360个金项观测上评估；采用分层模型判断审计（423个观测）与对称引文验证策略；并进行改述问题、缺省触发回退及配对生产研究。

Result: 无辅助召回平均0.26，有grounding召回0.92，但相对copy增益一致为负（-0.067至-0.022）。11,360个观测中仅3个未暴露项获得词汇学分。审计估计97.1%的获学分项确实断言了所需关系，但3个未暴露学分均未通过关系裁定。在未被脚手架暴露的目标上，词汇恢复从无辅助0.121降至grounded 0.004；改述问题使暴露从0.964降至0.328；缺省回退仅在506问中2问激活。配对生产研究判断质量提升+0.27，但负对照未能确立内容特异性。

Conclusion: exposure accounting可作为语料派生评测的常设控制。它能区分暴露项的遗漏与超越暴露的恢复，但不能判定推理是否真正发生。结果警示：grounding提升很可能主要反映上下文暴露而非结构推理。

Abstract: When a language model answers from a curated corpus via graph-based retrieval, a large grounding uplift does not establish reasoning over the retrieved structure: the context may already expose the gold answers. We propose exposure accounting, which classifies each gold item by whether the shown context exposes it and whether the answer recovers it. Its scalar reference is the copy ceiling, the recall a verbatim copy of the context achieves; signed gain over copy measures the model's recall relative to this deterministic, judge-free baseline. Across ten models, unaided recall averages 0.26 and grounded recall 0.92, yet gain over copy is uniformly negative (-0.067 to -0.022). Of 11,360 gold-item observations, representing 1,136 target instances evaluated under ten models, only three unexposed items receive lexical credit. A stratified model-judged audit of 423 observations, with a symmetric quotation-verification policy, estimates that 97.1% of credited items assert the requested relation; all three unexposed credits fail relational adjudication. On targets the scaffold does not expose, lexical recovery falls from 0.121 unaided to 0.004 grounded; adjudication validates 71 of the 92 unaided credits and none of the three grounded credits, without establishing full-frame relational recovery rates. Rephrasing questions outside the graph's title vocabulary reduces exposure from 0.964 to 0.328, while an absence-triggered fallback activates on only 2 of 506 questions. A paired production study improves judged quality by +0.27 pooled, but negative controls do not establish content specificity beyond a well-formed on-corpus block. These results support exposure accounting as a standing control for corpus-derived evaluations. The accounting distinguishes exposed-item omissions from beyond-exposure recoveries; it does not determine whether reasoning occurred.

</details>


### [390] [OSWorld-Pro: Process-based Evaluation for Computer Use Agents](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.24890)
*Zhilin Wang,Shaokun Zhang,Yifan Zhang,Hao Zhang,Jin Xu,Binfeng Xu,Jian Hu,Yunheng Zou,Karan Sapra,Andrew Tao,Jan Kautz,Yi Dong*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 论文提出 OSWorld-Pro，一个包含 300+ 任务、2800+ 子目标和 67000+ 人工标注的基准，用于对计算机使用智能体（CUA）进行过程性评估，而非仅看最终结果。通过人类对齐的 LLM-Judge 评估子目标完成情况，揭示模型的失败模式和改进方向。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有 CUA 评估（如 OSWorld）只关注数百步后的最终交付物，用功能验证器打分，缺乏对失败过程和原因的透明性。例如键盘输入错误与点击定位错误需要不同的改进策略，但最终结果评估无法区分。

Method: 构建 OSWorld-Pro：300+ 任务、2800+ 子目标、基于 67000+ 人工标注；使用鲁棒且人类对齐的 LLM-Judge 评估各子目标的完成情况，追踪模型在一系列顺序依赖子目标上的进展。

Result: 即使最先进 LLM 也面临挑战，顶尖如 Claude Opus 5 仅达 75.7%，而 OSWorld 上为 83.4%；识别出多种过程性失败模式，如子目标无关动作、基于点击的错误等。

Conclusion: 过程性评估能揭示 CUA 的具体失败模式，为提升智能体性能与效率提供关键洞见。

Abstract: Evaluation of Computer-Use Agents (CUAs) is often limited to the final deliverables they create (at the end of hundreds of steps) and assessed with functional verifiers, as seen in OSWorld. However, such evaluation of end-state performance lacks transparency into how and why agents fail in various tasks, obfuscating critical insight for subsequent improvement. For instance, agents that err during keyboard inputs would require a different mitigation strategy from those that fail to precisely provide click-based inputs on the graphical UI. We introduce OSWorld-Pro: a set of over 300 tasks containing over 2800 subgoals to enable the procedural evaluation of CUAs grounded in over 67,000 human annotations. We use robust human-aligned LLM-Judges to evaluate the fulfillment of OSWorld-Pro subgoals and thereby reveal the progress that models make throughout a series of sequentially dependent subgoals. Our findings reveal that OSWorld-Pro is challenging even for state-of-the-art LLMs, with top performers like Claude Opus 5 achieving only 75.7% vs. 83.4% on OSWorld. Furthermore, we identify critical process-focused failure modes of various models (e.g. subgoal-irrelevant actions and click-based mistakes) to provide insights to improve performance and efficiency of CUAs.

</details>


### [391] [Human-LLM Deliberation as Interactive Proof: Conditions for Verifiability Without Transparency](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.24895)
*Baotong Zhang,Dean Foster,João Sedoc*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文将人-LLM论证审议建模为交互式证明：LLM 为无限制搜索的证明者，人类为资源受限的验证者，通过累积局部检查证据实现任意时间有效的可靠性，并给出有限视野下的完备性界限。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 当 LLM 给出用户难以自行构造的论证时，用户缺乏判断其主张真伪的依据。受交互式证明启发，作者希望形式化人类与 LLM 的审议过程，为"何时可接受 LLM 主张"提供理论基础。

Method: 将审议建模为证明者与资源受限验证者的交互。验证者在不访问 LLM 内部状态的情况下请求并检查支持性细节，通过的检查累积为接受证据并达到接受阈值。假设任务提供误通过率与人类检查错误率的边界，且这些边界在任意相关历史后仍有效。

Result: 证明了针对自适应证明者的任意时间有效可靠性：接受虚假主张的概率至多不超过预设错误水平。有限视野完备性界限还需诚实回应充分性与足够诊断进展的边界。更多检查能强化接受证据，但每次都需要新的充分回应与可靠的人类努力。

Conclusion: 能否实现认证取决于验证者的努力预算、认知负荷、专业水平与疲劳程度。作者识别出在相同资源预算下，给定边界可认证特定局部检查序列、却无法认证特定全局检查的条件。

Abstract: When an LLM supplies an argument that a user could not readily construct, how can the user decide whether to accept its claim? Inspired by interactive proofs, we model human-LLM deliberation as an interaction between a prover with unrestricted internal search and a resource-bounded human verifier. The verifier requests and checks supporting details without access to the LLM's internal state. Passed checks accumulate evidence toward an acceptance threshold. We prove anytime-valid soundness against adaptive provers: the probability of ever accepting a false claim is at most a chosen error level, provided the task supplies bounds on false passes and human checking errors that remain valid after every relevant history. A finite-horizon completeness bound additionally requires bounds on the adequacy of honest responses and sufficient diagnostic progress. Further checks can strengthen the evidence for acceptance, but each requires another adequate response and reliable human effort. Whether this tradeoff permits certification depends on the verifier's effort budget, cognitive load, expertise, and fatigue. We identify conditions under which the supplied bounds certify a specified sequence of local checks but not a specified global check under the same resource budgets.

</details>


### [392] [ToneCL: Contrastive Learning for Few-Shot Syllable-Level Tone Classification](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.24903)
*Qisheng Liao,Youngah Do*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: ToneCL是一个轻量级对比学习框架，用于少样本音节级声调分类，在低资源条件下表现优异。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 声调语言占全球语言50-70%，但大多为低资源语言，缺乏大规模转写语料。现有数据集多为句子级，而田野语言学家需要细粒度音节级标注。

Method: 提出ToneCL对比学习框架，在无标注语音上使用保持声调特性的增强进行预训练，再用少量样本微调。在普通话和越南语上模拟低资源条件，每类声调仅数十样本。

Result: 优于基线，六说话人普通话10-shot达91.6%；跨语言迁移有效，越南语预训练+普通话微调达91.0%；消融显示频带拒绝是最关键的增强。

Conclusion: ToneCL有效解决低资源音节级声调分类问题，且具备跨语言迁移能力。

Abstract: Tone languages constitute over 50-70% of the world's languages, but the vast majority are low-resource, lacking the large transcribed corpora needed for automatic tone classification. Existing datasets are typically collected at the sentence level, whereas field linguists require fine-grained syllable-level annotations. We propose ToneCL, a lightweight contrastive learning framework for few-shot syllable-level tone classification. We simulate low-resource conditions on Mandarin and Vietnamese, limiting labeled data to tens of examples per tone class. ToneCL is pretrained on unlabeled speech with augmentations that preserve tonal identity, then fine-tuned on few-shot examples. Experiments show our method consistently outperforms baselines, achieving 91.6% on six-speaker Mandarin at 10 shots. Cross-lingual transfer is also effective: pretraining on Vietnamese and fine-tuning on Mandarin reaches 91.0\% accuracy at 10 shots. Ablation confirms that frequency band rejection is the most critical augmentation.

</details>


### [393] [SocioVerse2: A Longitudinal Dynamic Social Simulation Framework under a Human-AI Co-evolutionary Paradigm](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.24911)
*Xinnong Zhang,Jiayu Lin,Jia Wang,Yixu Huang,Xinyi Mou,Yingqian Wu,Jingcong Liang,Shijun Lei,Jianing Shi,Guanying Li,Siyuan Wang,Hanjia Lyu,Zhenfei Yin,Yunlu Yin,Siming Chen,Yulan He,Jiebo Luo,Xuanjing Huang,Liyin Jin,Baohua Zhou,Hanqi Yan,Zhongyu Wei*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: SocioVerse2 提出人-AI 共演化社会仿真范式，通过纵向仿真环与可控研究环，支持内容干预与研究过程可控，并在多案例中验证。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有社会仿真平台能验证集体行为、横截面对齐社会、用自主智能体开展研究，但缺乏两项系统支持：对仿真内容的干预，以及研究者对仿真生成过程的控制。

Method: 在 SocioVerse 1.0 基础上扩展为“两环一基础设施”：纵向仿真环以演化环境模拟目标人群，并通过干预分叉反事实分支；可控研究环将研究本身视为可编辑状态并进行版本更新；社会科学生成式基础设施以可组合技能与研究检查点、五个 persona 池的人口服务、含 21 个真实信号源且具备时点保证的环境服务支撑两环。

Result: 在三个案例族、七个案例研究中验证，包括复现经典 ABM、基于真实记录建模政策过程，以及预测超出模型知识截止的宏观经济指标。

Conclusion: 人-AI 共演化范式使这些案例超越系统演示，成为研究各自学科前沿问题的实质性研究；代码、数据服务与工作台已开源。

Abstract: Social simulation offers the social sciences an experimental instrument that the real world cannot supply, and generative agents have transformed it by acting as silicon samples that unite agent-based modeling with real behavioral data. Existing platforms verify collective behavior, align simulated populations with real societies in cross-sections, and employ autonomous agents for the research process. However, two social science requirements remain without systematic support: intervention in the content of a simulation and the researcher's control over the process that produces it. We present SocioVerse2, which extends SocioVerse 1.0 into a human-AI co-evolutionary paradigm built from two loops and one infrastructure. The longitudinal simulation loop simulates the target population with evolving environments and forks counterfactual branches via interventions. The controllable research loop takes the study itself as an editable state and updates state versions via controllable editing. The social science agentic infrastructure carries both loops through composable skills with researcher checkpoints, a population service over five persona pools, and an environment service over 21 real-world signal sources with point-in-time guarantees. We validate SocioVerse2 across three case families and seven case studies, from reproducing canonical agent-based models to modeling policy processes on real records and nowcasting macro-economic indices beyond the response model's knowledge cutoff. With the human-AI co-evolutionary paradigm, these cases go beyond system demonstrations to become substantive studies that investigate frontier questions in their respective disciplines. Code, data services, and a workbench are released as open-source resources.

</details>


### [394] [Linguistic Features for Interpretable Textual Entailment](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.24932)
*David Torres-Moreno,Jorge Hermosillo-Valadez,Asela Reig-Alamillo*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: SLITE是一个可解释的混合RTE模型。它结合结构-关系层与分布式-信息层，提出17个特征，用逻辑回归在SICK三分类上达83%、SICK-CE上达96%的准确率，性能接近RoBERTa但计算复杂度低得多。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 神经模型在NLP中表现优异，但其黑箱特性限制了可解释性，并掩盖了预测背后的语言现象。作者希望提出可解释的混合方法，作为大规模神经架构的可行替代，并促进语言学理论与计算建模的对话。

Method: 将RTE任务分解为两层语义分析：1）结构-关系层，基于组合实体间的语义兼容与不兼容；2）分布式-信息层，基于premise与hypothesis的嵌入表示之间信息变化的结构化模式。共设计17个特征，涵盖实体级语义关系、极性敏感的词汇匹配，以及对相似度矩阵的语义子表示进行对齐度量（包括熵和转移熵）。使用逻辑回归进行训练。

Result: 在SICK三分类上准确率83%，在SICK-CE上96%，比IsoLex高出4个百分点，与RoBERTa相差2个百分点以内，但计算复杂度仅为其一小部分。消融实验和SHAP分析确认结构-关系特征是分类的主要驱动力，分布式-信息特征提供重要互补贡献，尤其在检测中立和矛盾时。

Conclusion: 进一步探索混合方法是可行且科学上有成效的替代方案，可替代庞大的神经架构，并有望加强语言学理论与推理计算建模之间的对话。

Abstract: Despite the success of neural models in natural language processing, their black-box nature limits interpretability and conceals the linguistic phenomena underlying their predictions. We present SLITE, an explainable hybrid model for Recognizing Textual Entailment that integrates two complementary layers of semantic analysis: a structural-relational layer, based on semantic compatibility and incompatibility between compositional entities, and a distributional-informational layer, based on structured patterns of information change between embedding-based representations of the premise and the hypothesis. We propose 17 features that combine entity-level semantic relations, polarity-sensitive lexical matching, and alignment measures over semantic sub-representations of the similarity matrix, including measures based on entropy and transfer entropy. A logistic regression trained on these features achieves an accuracy of 83% on three-class SICK and 96% on SICK-CE, outperforming IsoLex by 4 percentage points and falling within 2 percentage points of RoBERTa with a fraction of its computational complexity. Ablation studies and SHAP analysis confirm that structural-relational features are the primary drivers of classification, while distributional-informational features provide essential complementary contributions, particularly for detecting neutrality and contradiction. Our results demonstrate that further exploration of hybrid approaches is a viable and scientifically productive alternative to massive neural architectures, and we hope they will strengthen the dialogue between linguistic theory and computational modeling of inference

</details>


### [395] [Jev for Scientific Decisions: Evaluating Semantic Choices and Their Consequences](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.24965)
*Boyuan Deng,Shuyi Fan,Hongyang Zhang,Xinhong Xie*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 论文评估Jev作为科学工作流语义决策组件，发现其在语义选择准确性和延迟上表现良好，但错误关系选择可能改变下游计算量而保持最终结论标签正确。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 科学工作流需要在确定性计算前选择已知关系（如文化、处理或参考标准是否共享），这些语义选择会改变计数或比较的科学含义，因此需要评估模型的语义决策能力。

Method: 使用遵循Jev文档指导的测试框架，将算术分配给代码，在10个科学案例的20个有来源依据的Choices上比较12种模型配置，每个重复5次，分别测量语义选择、下游输出和最终结论标签。

Result: Jev在完全语义正确性上与另外五个配置并列，且在成功响应中达到最低的中位延迟；在三个对比模型中，一个文化历史问题上的七个错误选择改变了下游计数，但最终标签仍正确。

Conclusion: Jev在准备好的科学决策任务中具有实用价值，但评估其作用必须检查工作流将复用的关系和数量，而不能只看最终标签。

Abstract: Scientific workflows often require choosing among known relations before a deterministic calculation can proceed. Whether observations share a culture, treatment or reference standard can change the scientific meaning of the resulting count or comparison. We evaluate Jev as a semantic decision component using a harness that follows its documented guidance and assigns arithmetic to code. The study compares twelve model configurations on twenty source-grounded Choices across ten scientific cases, each repeated five times. We measure semantic selections, downstream outputs and final claim labels separately. Jev matched five other configurations at complete semantic correctness and achieved the lowest observed median latency among successful responses. Across three comparison models, seven wrong selections on one culture-history question changed downstream counts while preserving the correct final label. These results identify a useful role for Jev in prepared scientific decision tasks and show why evaluating that role requires checking the relations and quantities that a workflow will reuse.

</details>


### [396] [DolphinBench: Mapping the Pareto Frontier of Agent Memory](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.24971)
*Soumil Rathi,Deshraj Yadav,Taranjeet Singh*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: DolphinBench 是一个通过智能体任务完成度直接评估记忆能力的基准，包含三个知识工作角色，每人约 50 万 token 历史，共 600 个任务，并要求同时报告成本与延迟。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有记忆基准多采用对话问答形式，问题本身已暗示需检索某事实，且只要求准确率，导致记忆系统可能以不合理的成本/时间换取高分，无法全面评估智能体的长期记忆能力。

Method: 构建 DolphinBench：包含三个知识工作角色，每人约 50 万 token 用户消息；设计每人 200 个依赖历史信息的任务；通过有无相关历史的对照实验验证任务（有历史成功、无历史失败）；要求评估同时报告总成本与延迟。

Result: 该基准在三个维度（直接任务完成评估、对照验证任务、成本与延迟报告）上均优于现有基准，作者称没有现有记忆基准同时具备这三点。

Conclusion: DolphinBench 提供了更贴近真实、更全面的智能体记忆系统评估方式，数据集与评估代码已公开。

Abstract: Agents today often take real-world actions that depend on long-term memory and context recall over time. However, most current memory benchmarks are built for a conversational question-answer format, where the question itself signals that some fact must be retrieved, and often which one. Moreover, benchmarks rarely require anything beyond accuracy from submissions, allowing memory systems to make unreasonable cost/time tradeoffs to achieve higher scores.
  We present DolphinBench, a benchmark that evaluates memory directly through an agent's task completion. DolphinBench includes three knowledge-work personas with roughly 500k tokens of user messages per persona and evaluates agents on tasks that depend on information from that history. We verify all 200 tasks per persona by running an agent with and without the relevant history, requiring success with it and failure without it.
  Finally, we require all evaluations to report total cost and latency alongside accuracy, which enables us to evaluate agent memory systems holistically. No existing memory benchmark combines all three. The dataset and evaluation code are available at https://dolphinbench.ai.

</details>


### [397] [onPanda: Efficient Annotation of On-Policy Alignment Data for LLMs and Agents via Token-Level Correction](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.24983)
*Lei Yang,Mengyin Liu,Jia Wang,Hangyu Guo,Liang Zhao,Zheng Ge,Kang An,Binxing Jiao,Qi Han,Daxin Jiang,Siqi Shen,Xiangyu Zhang*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: onPanda 是一种交互式标注工具，通过“定位-纠正-续写”循环在 token 级别高效标注 LLM 对齐数据与智能体轨迹。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有 LLM 对齐数据与轨迹标注成本高、效率低，需要一种能精准引导模型输出且保留采样分布的标注方式。

Method: 以 token 级纠正为核心交互：标注者定位首个不当 token，从候选或自由编辑中选择替代，截断后续内容并从修正前缀继续生成，循环直至满意；同时支持连接外部工具进行真实环境轨迹标注。

Result: 小规模对照研究显示，相比人工后编辑，onPanda 将中位标注时间减少 52%；产出的数据保留模型采样分布，适合构建 on-policy SFT 与偏好数据，并提供位置精准、正负样本成对的细粒度监督。同时发布 Panda-CVL 数据集与 token 级纠正 benchmark。

Conclusion: onPanda 通过低成本、高精度的 token 级交互，兼顾标注效率与数据质量，适用于 LLM 对齐及智能体轨迹标注。

Abstract: We present onPanda, an interactive tool for efficiently annotating LLM alignment data and agent trajectories. onPanda adopts token-level correction as its core interaction: while reading a model response, the annotator locates the first inappropriate token and either picks a substitute from the model's candidate tokens or types the correct text via free-form editing. The system then truncates everything after that position and continues generation from the corrected prefix, repeating this locate-correct-continue loop until a satisfactory response is obtained. This mechanism lets annotators precisely steer model outputs at low cost: a small controlled study suggests that onPanda reduces median annotation time by 52% over manual post-editing. Since the vast majority of tokens in the final response are generated by the model itself, the resulting data largely preserves the model's sampling distribution and is well suited for constructing on-policy SFT and preference data. Furthermore, the token-level corrections recorded during annotation provide fine-grained supervision with precise positions and naturally paired positive--negative samples. onPanda also connects to external tools and harnesses, enabling interactive trajectory annotation in realistic environments. In addition, we release Panda-CVL, a dataset annotated with onPanda, together with a benchmark for token-level correction.

</details>


<div id='cs.NE'></div>

# cs.NE [[Back]](#toc)

### [398] [Artificial Neural Networks as Surrogate Models in Black Box Optimization](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.22329)
*Md Khadimul Islam Zim,Martin Holeňa*

Main category: cs.NE

TL;DR: 本文提出AFN-CMA-ES，一种基于人工神经网络的新型代理模型，用于黑箱优化中的选择性目标函数评估，性能优于现有代理辅助BBO方法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 黑箱优化依赖目标函数值而无法获得解析表达式，常需大量评估；当评估耗时或昂贵时，代理辅助优化虽能减少真实评估次数，但仍面临小数据学习问题，需要更高效的代理模型来在有限预算下引导搜索。

Method: 提出名为Adaptive-Fidelity Nexus Covariance Matrix Adaptation Evolution Strategy (AFN-CMA-ES)的方法，利用人工神经网络构建新型代理模型，对目标函数进行选择性评估，以数据高效的方式引导搜索。

Result: 实验结果表明，AFN-CMA-ES相较于当前最先进的代理辅助黑箱优化方法具有竞争力的性能。

Conclusion: 将人工神经网络代理模型与CMA-ES结合可有效应对有限评估预算下的黑箱优化，具有实际应用潜力。

Abstract: Black-Box Optimization (BBO) is often applied in several engineering fields and can utilize an advancement of numerical measure- ments and simulation technologies. It deals with the optimization func- tions, where an analytical description is unavailable. It relies on meth- ods that require only an input point in the search space, paired with its corresponding objective function value, obtained through non-analytical means, e.g., sensors, experiments, or simulations. Common approaches include evolutionary optimization and other metaheuristics. Since BBO methods rely solely on objective function values, they typically require many evaluations, which becomes problematic when evaluating the ob- jective function is time-consuming or expensive. This leads to using surrogate-based optimization which evaluates selected true objective val- ues and trains a regression model to approximate the objective function across the search space. Surrogate-assisted black-box optimization is a small-data learning problem because the optimizer must approximate an expensive objective function from limited evaluations. Surrogate models act as data-efficient regressors, guiding the search toward promising or informative points under a restricted evaluation budget. In this paper, a new surrogate model using artificial neural networks, called Adaptive- Fidelity Nexus Covariance Matrix Adaptation Evolution Strategy (AFN- CMA-ES), is proposed for the selective evaluation of objective functions. The experimental results show its competitive performance compared to state-of-the-art surrogate-assisted BBO methods.

</details>


### [399] [Sensing to Intelligence: Principles for Neuromorphic Circuits and Systems](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.22838)
*Saptarshi Maiti,Chetan Singh Thakur*

Main category: cs.NE

TL;DR: 本文提出神经形态工程应由"是否借鉴生物计算原理并使其在设计上发挥因果作用"来定义，而非由器件、信号或与生物组件的相似度定义。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 神经形态工程从模拟电路扩展到事件传感器、脉冲处理器、新兴存储器、混合信号系统和神经加速器，领域不断扩张导致"神经形态"一词含义过于宽泛、缺乏清晰界定。

Method: Perspective观点文章：通过综述传感、集体计算、记忆、学习与交互等方向，提出以生物计算原理的"因果性、设计相关性"为核心的判据，并总结一套神经形态系统设计原则。

Result: 以适应、非线性动力学、吸引子结构、变异性与闭环动作等为例，说明计算可嵌入机器演化中的物理状态。

Conclusion: 神经形态工程的核心问题应从"机器多像神经系统"转向"理解并转化其原理后能实现何种新计算"，为走向广泛部署提供方向。

Abstract: Neuromorphic engineering began with the idea that the physical behavior of a system could itself be used for computation, taking inspiration from the way nervous systems sense, adapt, and evolve in time. The field has since expanded far beyond its early analog circuits to include event-based sensors, spiking processors, emerging memory devices, mixed-signal systems, and large-scale neural accelerators. With this expansion, however, the meaning of neuromorphic has become increasingly broad. In this Perspective, we argue that neuromorphic engineering should be defined neither by resemblance to biological components nor by any particular device, signal representation, or substrate. Its potential lies in identifying computational principles in biological systems and translating them into the organization and dynamics of artificial machines. A system is truly neuromorphic when the invoked biological or physical principle plays a causal, design-relevant role in how information is represented, how state evolves, or what capability the complete system achieves. We develop this view across sensing, collective computation, memory, learning, and interaction. Adaptation, nonlinear dynamics, attractor structure, variability, and closed-loop action illustrate how computation can be embedded in a machine's evolving physical state. From these examples, we identify a set of design principles for neuromorphic systems. As neuromorphic engineering moves toward wider deployment, this perspective shifts the central question from how closely machines resemble nervous systems to what computation becomes possible when their principles are understood and deliberately translated into new machines.

</details>


### [400] [Genetic Programming with Behaviour-based Niching for Learning Guided Local Search in Vehicle Routing Problems](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.24104)
*Saining Liu,Yi Mei,Mengjie Zhang*

Main category: cs.NE

TL;DR: 提出BN-GPGLS，用六种算子级行为描述符刻画GP程序，通过行为分层的归档选择保持群体多样性，并与无归档及适应度型niche方法对比。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: GPGLS进化的程序可能适应度相近但搜索行为不同，仅用适应度管理群体多样性不充分。

Method: BN-GPGLS在局部搜索中采集六个算子级描述符，利用当代归档从行为分数分层中选出适应度竞争且紧凑的代表；固定策略持续使用归档父代，自适应策略依据训练适应度与标准化行为离散度信号激活，并可加入树规模条件。在30次种子匹配的200客户生成实例上与无归档对照及适应度型niche对比，另用90实例监测集评估。

Result: BN-Adaptive在监测集上取得最佳平均排名，路径成本差异较小；五种归档策略的最终种群树规模中位数均低于对照，配对Wilcoxon检验经Holm校正后仍显著。

Conclusion: 结果揭示了在所评估设定下解质量与程序规模的权衡，但未将规模缩减单独归因于行为表示。

Abstract: Genetic Programming Guided Local Search (GPGLS) learns utility functions that guide local search for vehicle routing. Its evolving programs can have similar fitness while inducing different search behaviour, making fitness alone an incomplete basis for population diversity management. We propose GPGLS with Behaviour-based Niching (BN-GPGLS), which characterises programs through six operator-level descriptors collected during local search. A current-generation archive selects fitness-competitive, compact representatives from strata of a behaviour score. Fixed policies use archive parents continuously, whereas adaptive policies activate them using training-fitness and standardised behaviour-dispersion signals, optionally with a tree-size condition. We compare four behaviour-based variants with a no-archive GPGLS control and fitness-based niching over 30 seed-matched runs on generated 200-customer instances. BN-Adaptive achieves the best descriptive average rank on a separate 90-instance monitoring set; aggregate routing-cost differences are small. All five archive policies produce lower final-population median tree sizes than the GPGLS control, with paired Wilcoxon comparisons remaining significant after Holm adjustment. These results identify useful solution-quality and program-size trade-offs within the evaluated setting, without attributing the size reductions to behaviour representation alone.

</details>


### [401] [DCL-GPGLS: Dynamic Curriculum Learning for Genetic Programming Guided Local Search in Large-Scale Vehicle Routing](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.24105)
*Saining Liu,Yi Mei,Mengjie Zhang*

Main category: cs.NE

TL;DR: 提出DCL-GPGLS，用当前种群解质量动态估计实例难度并更新课程，提升GP guided local search训练效率。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: GPGLS在大规模VRP上评估每个GP个体代价高，通常用小批量训练；现有课程方法ACL-GPGLS虽能自适应切换阶段，但实例难度顺序仍预先固定。

Method: DCL-GPGLS根据当前种群解质量估计每个训练实例难度，并在进化中更新；每代选取接近计划难度水平的批次，并加纠正机制限制重复选择同一实例。

Result: 在CVRPLIB X固定训练-测试划分上，DCL-GPGLS在六种训练策略中取得最佳平均排名和平均测试成本；在65个未见测试实例中36个最低平均成本，与静态反馈课程在相同总评估次数下6个显著更优、59个无显著差异。

Conclusion: 动态难度估计与批次选择可优于固定难度顺序的课程GP方法，在不大幅增加评估预算下提升GPGLS训练效率与测试表现。

Abstract: Genetic Programming Guided Local Search (GPGLS) uses genetic programming to evolve utility functions for guided local search in large-scale vehicle routing problems (LSVRPs). Evaluating every GP individual on every training instance at every generation is expensive, so GPGLS is usually trained on small instance batches. Existing curriculum-based GPGLS orders these batches mainly by instance size. Adaptive Curriculum Learning GPGLS (ACL-GPGLS) improves training efficiency by adapting when the search moves between fixed curriculum stages, but the instance difficulty order remains predefined. We propose DCL-GPGLS, which estimates the difficulty of each training instance from the current population's solution quality and updates the estimates during evolution. Each generation then receives a batch near a scheduled difficulty level, with a correction that limits repeated selection of the same instances. Experiments on a fixed training-test split of the CVRPLIB X set show that DCL-GPGLS achieves the best observed average rank and mean test cost among six training policies. It obtains the lowest mean cost on 36 of 65 unseen test instances and is significantly better than the static feedback-derived curriculum, matched in total evaluator calls, on 6 instances, with no significant difference on the remaining 59.

</details>


<div id='cs.SE'></div>

# cs.SE [[Back]](#toc)

### [402] [When Who You Are Can Change the Code You Get: A Study of Persona-Induced Bias in LLM Code Generation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.22102)
*Anubhav Gupta,Mayara Costa Figueiredo,Leticia Santos Machado,Tanner Wright,Ivan Beschastnikh,Cleidson R. B. de Souza,Gema Rodríguez-Pérez*

Main category: cs.SE

TL;DR: 本文大规模实证研究用户人口统计角色提示对LLM代码生成质量的影响，发现人口特征常泄露到推理和输出中，并导致可测量的正确性差异。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: LLM广泛用作编程助手，但用户人口统计信息是否及如何影响生成代码的技术质量尚不明确。

Method: 针对Gemini 2.5 Pro与GPT-OSS-120B，使用18种人口统计persona（国籍、性别、经验水平），与中性基线对比，生成超35000个程序，分析推理/响应中的人口标记泄露及功能正确性、可维护性、代码风格和安全性差异。

Result: 人口标记在响应中最高达65%、推理轨迹中达70%；LiveCodeBench上Gemini正确率平均下降1.54个百分点（某persona下降3.6%，OR=0.51），GPT-OSS则提升3.4-5.7%（OR=1.8-3.0）；可维护性和风格效应显著但极小（Cliff's δ<0.15），安全性无系统性模式。

Conclusion: 用户人口统计信息的存在与LLM推理和代码质量的可测量变异相关，且跨模型成立，揭示了LLM辅助软件开发中被忽视的风险。

Abstract: Large Language Models (LLMs) are widely used as programming assistants, yet it remains unclear whether and how user's demographic information impacts the technical quality of generated code. We conduct a large-scale empirical study of persona-induced bias in LLM-based code generation, focusing a proprietary model (Gemini 2.5 Pro) and an open-weight model (GPT-OSS-120B). Using 18 demographic personas spanning nationality, gender, and experience level, we compare persona-induced prompts against a neutral baseline. Across 35,000+ generated programs, we analyze demographic marker leakage in reasoning and responses, as well as differences in functional correctness, maintainability, code style, and security.
  Our results show that demographic cues are frequently reflected in LLM reasoning and outputs. Demographic markers appear in up to 65% of responses and 70% of reasoning traces, despite being semantically irrelevant to the tasks. On LiveCodeBench, persona prompting were associated with lower correctness scores of the Gemini model by an average of 1.54 percentage points, with one persona exhibiting a decrease of 3.6% (odds ratio = 0.51). In contrast, the accuracy of the GPT-OSS model improved by 3.4 - 5.7% across all personas (odds ratios = 1.8 - 3.0). Maintainability and code style metrics show statistically significant but negligible effect sizes (all Cliff's δ < 0.15), and security vulnerabilities exhibit no systematic persona-specific patterns.
  Overall, our results show that the presence of demographic information about users is associated with measurable variation in LLM reasoning and code quality even in purely technical tasks, and that these effects hold across models. Our work highlights an under-examined risk in LLM-assisted software development.

</details>


### [403] [A Governance-Aware Large Language Model Orchestrated Agentic Digital Twin for Transmission System Operator Control Room Decision Support](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.22476)
*Costas Mylonas,Magda Foti,Emmanouel Varvarigos*

Main category: cs.SE

TL;DR: 本文提出面向输电控制室的治理感知智能体数字孪生：LLM仅能选择并参数化白名单工具，所有动作经不可绕过的治理层校验四条规则，在118任务基准上验证工具选择96.5%、任务成功率93.7%，规则全部成立，单次开销12–16毫秒。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 可再生能源并网、惯性下降与安全裕度收紧使输电系统运营商面临日益复杂的调度压力；LLM可提供自然语言决策支持，但其幻觉、不受控工具调用和可追溯性差与控制室要求相冲突。

Method: 构建治理感知的智能体数字孪生（以希腊输电网络为孪生对象）。LLM仅负责选择与参数化白名单分析工具；每次运行均通过模型无法绕过的治理层，强制执行四条规则：仅执行白名单工具、不超步数预算、有副作用动作须经操作员显式批准、答案中每个数字由治理层基于后端结果并标注单位/变量/时间渲染；规则在持久化审计轨迹上逐次运行校验。

Result: 在118任务基准（含分析、仿真、多步工作流及12类对抗输入）上：主模型590次运行中工具选择率96.5%、任务成功率93.7%，四条规则无一例外成立。跨4个LLM的三次重复研究中总计1416次运行，规则每次均成立，约95%下界为99.8%。移除治理层后，同一模型在全部45次需批准运行中未经授权执行，仅39.2%答案含后端支持的数字；治理执行开销为每请求12–16毫秒。

Conclusion: 治理层可在可忽略延迟成本下为LLM驱动的电网控制提供严格的安全、可追溯与授权保障，避免幻觉与越权工具使用，适合控制室部署。

Abstract: Transmission system operators face rising complexity from renewable integration, reduced inertia, and tighter security margins. Large language models offer natural-language decision support, but their hallucinations, uncontrolled tool use, and weak traceability conflict with control room requirements. This paper presents a governance-aware agentic digital twin for transmission grid control rooms. The large language model only selects and parameterizes whitelisted analysis tools, and every proposed action passes through a governance layer that the model cannot bypass. The layer enforces four rules on every run. Only whitelisted tools execute. No run exceeds its step budget. No action with side effects executes without explicit operator approval. Every number in an answer is rendered by the layer from backend results with its unit, variable, and time. The rules are checked on a persistent audit trail for every run of a released 118-task benchmark, which covers analytics, simulation, multi-step workflows, and twelve families of adversarial inputs on a digital twin of the Greek transmission network. Across 590 runs of the primary model, tool selection reaches 96.5% and task success 93.7%, and all four rules hold without exception. In a separate three-repetition study across four large language models, 1416 runs in total, the rules again hold on every run, with an approximate 95% lower bound of 99.8%. Removing the layer makes the same model execute all 45 approval-requiring runs without authorization and leaves only 39.2% of its answers with backend-supported numbers. Enforcement costs 12 to 16 milliseconds per request.

</details>


### [404] [Identity or Prompt Noise? A Calibrated Invariance Audit of LLM Code Generation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.22511)
*Maksim E. Eren,Ryan Barron,Eric Michalak,Charles Nicholas,Manish Bhattarai*

Main category: cs.SE

TL;DR: 审计3073万次Python代码生成，发现职业身份导致小而可复现的代码形式变化，但无稳定的身份劣势或下游危害证据。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 身份线索本应对固定的编程规范无关，但原始反事实差异可能源于样本不均和提示措辞。作者希望厘清模型是否因身份信息（性别、国家、职业）产生系统性偏见。

Method: 在HumanEval+和MBPP+上对7个检查点共30.73百万次Python生成进行审计，辅以550B探索性切片。采用模型分配的性别、国家和职业人格设定，结合任务内随机化与错误发现率（FDR）控制，并用CodeBLEU离散度与交换性零假设对比。

Result: 职业是最一致的结构性轴：CodeBLEU离散度在10/14模型-基准单元中超过零假设，8/12全覆盖单元仍显著，在每对单元中均超过国家比率，但中位超额仅0.141点。6个高通过率单元中职业离散度在token相似度、长度、注释、参考相似度和复杂度上可复现，而通过率离散度均不显著。国家在12/14单元中原始离散度领先，但中位校准比率为1.00。性别相关变异无法与人格措辞分离。

Conclusion: 证据支持职业条件下代码形式的微小且可复现变化，而非对特定身份的稳定劣势或已证实的下游危害。作者据此呼吁更广泛讨论代码生成偏见的影响，包括模型可能基于对话上下文中的身份信息调整输出。

Abstract: Identity cues are irrelevant to a fixed programming specification, but raw counterfactual differences can arise from unequal samples and prompt wording. We audit 30.73 million executed Python generations from seven checkpoints on HumanEval+ and MBPP+, supplemented by an exploratory 550B slice, under model-assigned gender, country, and occupation personas. Within-task randomization and false-discovery-rate control identify occupation as the most consistent structural axis: CodeBLEU dispersion exceeds its exchangeability null in 10/14 model--benchmark cells, remains significant in 8/12 full-coverage cells, and exceeds the country ratio in every paired cell, although the median excess is only 0.141 points. In six high-pass-rate cells, occupation dispersion replicates across token similarity, length, comments, reference similarity, and complexity, while pass-rate dispersion is significant in none. Country leads raw dispersion in 12/14 cells but has a median calibrated ratio of 1.00. Gender-associated variation cannot be separated from persona wording in this design. Thus, the evidence supports small, reproducible occupation-conditioned changes in code form, not stable disadvantage to named identities or demonstrated downstream harm. We use this finding to motivate a broader commentary on the potential impacts of bias in code generation, including the possibility that models may condition their outputs on identity information available from prior conversational context.

</details>


### [405] [Does Order Matter? An Empirical Investigation into the Impact of File Ordering on Code Review Effectiveness](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.22610)
*Md Shamimur Rahman,Zadia Codabux,Chanchal K. Roy*

Main category: cs.SE

TL;DR: 本文通过挖掘182个项目的33万余条多文件PR，研究文件排序与代码审查效果的关系，发现文件位置、PR规模与潜在bug率存在显著但温和的关联，且审查注意力随PR增大而被稀释，揭示出"注意力-效果"鸿沟。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 代码审查对软件质量至关重要，但效果受审查者专业度、变更特征及工具呈现方式影响。多数平台默认按字母顺序显示文件，而作者前期工作表明开发者认为该排序方式与理解多文件PR的认知过程不一致。这种排序相关的注意力模式是否在规模化场景下影响审查结果尚不明确。

Method: 对五种编程语言、182个GitHub项目的330,343条多文件PR及756,814个文件实例进行大规模挖掘分析。考察文件位置是否与后续bug修复变更相关、PR规模是否调节该关系，以及以评论为代理的审查注意力是否与潜在bug结果一致，并使用Hurdle模型建模。

Result: 文件位置、PR规模、审查活动与潜在bug可能性之间存在统计显著但温和的关联。潜在bug率从位置1的56.7%升至位置30的61.5%。PR规模与bug风险呈非线性关系：约10个文件的PR风险最低，极小和极大的PR风险偏高。Hurdle模型显示注意力随PR增大而稀释，每增加一个改动文件，收到任何审查评论的几率下降约8.7%。

Conclusion: 研究揭示了"注意力-效果"鸿沟：可见的审查活动并不必然防止缺陷。字母排序并非中立的界面默认设置，而是塑造注意力分配、审查覆盖率和审查结果信心的结构性特征。作者提出上下文感知的文件排序、依赖感知分组、风险感知优先级和逐文件覆盖率指示器等改进方案。

Abstract: Modern code review is central to software quality, but its effectiveness depends on reviewer expertise, change characteristics, and how tools present changes. Most platforms display modified files alphabetically by default, although our prior work shows that developers find this ordering cognitively misaligned with how they understand multi-file pull requests. Whether these ordering-related attention patterns affect outcomes at scale remains unclear. We present a large-scale study of file ordering and review effectiveness, mining 330,343 multi-file pull requests and 756,814 file instances from 182 GitHub projects in five programming languages. We examine whether file position is associated with later bug-fixing changes, whether pull request size moderates this relationship, and whether reviewer attention, proxied by comments, aligns with latent bug outcomes. Results show statistically significant but modest associations among file position, pull request size, review activity, and latent bug likelihood. Latent bug rates rise from 56.7% at position 1 to 61.5% at position 30. Pull request size has a non-linear relationship with latent bug likelihood: pull requests of about ten files have the lowest risk, while very small and very large ones have elevated rates. Hurdle models show that attention is diluted as pull request size grows: each additional modified file reduces the odds of receiving any review comment by about 8.7%. These findings reveal an attention-effectiveness gap: visible review activity does not necessarily prevent defects. Alphabetical ordering is therefore not a neutral interface default, but a structural feature shaping attention allocation, review coverage, and confidence in review outcomes. We propose context-aware file ordering, dependency-aware grouping, risk-aware prioritization, and per-file coverage indicators to make review attention more visible and actionable.

</details>


### [406] [Why Do Pull Requests Go Silent? Uncovering the Barriers to Contribution Completion in Open-Source Code Review](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.22625)
*Md Shamimur Rahman,Farhana Akter,Md Mustakim Billah,Zadia Codabux,Chanchal K. Roy*

Main category: cs.SE

TL;DR: 分析19个GitHub仓库中14,234个停滞PR和164,562条评论，揭示PR停滞的贡献类型、讨论层面障碍及后续协作模式。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: PR停滞导致贡献者和维护者努力浪费，但此前研究对贡献类型、讨论层面障碍及停滞后的协作模式了解不足。

Method: 用LLM投票分类器对停滞PR按贡献类型分类；结合定量分析与对一般/行内评论的定性编码。

Result: 功能增强和问题修复类PR占比超77%；一般评论显示停滞主因是沟通协调断裂；行内评论表明停滞常由技术/依赖问题导致；仅39.56%贡献者后续再提交PR，审阅者再参与约21%。

Conclusion: PR停滞是社会技术协调问题，涉及沟通、技术就绪、审阅责任与自动化实践，建议类型感知分诊、明确反馈与责任、CI阻塞管理和原因感知的stale-bot干预。

Abstract: Pull requests (PRs) underpin pull-based software development by enabling distributed code review and collaborative contribution in open-source projects. Yet many become inactive before integration and are eventually abandoned or closed, wasting contributor and maintainer effort. Although prior work has examined PR abandonment and review delays, less is known about the contribution types, discussion-level barriers, and post-stalling collaboration patterns associated with inactivity. We investigate which PR types most often stall, why inactivity occurs from authors' and reviewers' perspectives, and how stalling relates to later contributor and reviewer engagement. We analyzed 14,234 stalled PRs and 164,562 review comments from 19 popular GitHub repositories using stale-bot workflows. An LLM-based voting classifier categorized PRs by contribution type, while quantitative analysis was combined with qualitative coding of general and inline review discussions. Feature-enhancement and issue-fixing PRs formed the largest share, together exceeding 77% of classified stalled PRs. General comments linked stalling mainly to communication and coordination breakdowns, including missing interaction, delayed feedback, and unclear follow-up. Inline comments showed that inactivity does not always reflect disengagement: many PRs were blocked by technical or dependency issues, including failing checks, configuration problems, compatibility concerns, and environment mismatches. Only 39.56% of contributors later submitted another PR, and reviewer re-engagement with the same contributors was approximately 21%. PR inactivity is a socio-technical coordination problem involving communication, technical readiness, review ownership, and automation practices. We recommend type-aware triage, clearer review feedback, explicit ownership of next actions, CI blocker management, and cause-aware stale-bot interventions.

</details>


### [407] [From Code to Requirements: Agentic Reverse Engineering of Business Rules at Enterprise Scale](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.22719)
*Garima Agrawal,Prasun Das,Priyanka L,Minisha N,Akshay Sarvade,Hemath Manivanan,Sravani Joshna,Prasad Kalyansundaram*

Main category: cs.SE

TL;DR: 本文提出一个由七个专用智能体组成的代理框架，可自主反向工程无文档的企业软件，生成业务需求文档（bRD），在真实部署中每服务不到九分钟完成，成本较传统迁移降低超98%。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 企业软件的业务需求很少以结构化形式记录，逻辑散落在源代码、配置文件和机构记忆中。系统迁移、扩展或审计时缺乏正式需求工件，迫使团队进行昂贵且丢失知识的人工反向工程。

Method: 采用代理框架，七个专用智能体协作，从代码、测试套件、配置和可用文档中发现用户旅程、抽取业务规则并合成锁定的bRD；辅以静态分析工具，嵌入专家实践者的认知模型，并在受控升级点由人工评审监督。

Result: 基于真实企业部署的实际执行轨迹测量，框架每服务在九分钟内生成全面bRD；抽取的规则经真实生产缺陷记录独立佐证。对比同一目标架构的既有迁移耗时两年以上，本框架基于实际仓库指标（IFPUG复杂度模型与行业基准人力费率）的成本降低超过98%。

Conclusion: 代理框架可高效、低成本地将无文档企业软件反向工程为正式业务需求文档，显著优于传统人工迁移方式。

Abstract: Business requirements for enterprise software systems are rarely captured in structured form; the logic resides instead in source code, configuration files, and institutional memory. When these systems must be migrated, extended, or audited, the absence of formal requirements artifacts forces teams into expensive, knowledge-losing manual reverse engineering. This paper presents an agentic framework that autonomously generates Business Requirements Documents (bRDs) through reverse engineering of undocumented enterprise software. Seven specialized agents collaborate to discover user journeys, extract business rules, and synthesize a locked bRD from code, test suites, configuration, and available documentation, supported by static analysis tools, guided by embedded expert practitioner cognitive models, and overseen by human reviewers at controlled escalation points. Measured on actual execution traces across a real enterprise deployment, the framework generates comprehensive bRDs in under nine minutes per service, with extracted rules independently corroborated against real production defect records. In a comparable prior migration to the same target architecture, delivery required over two years; on the present programme the framework achieves a cost reduction exceeding 98% against a baseline derived from actual repository metrics using IFPUG complexity models and industry benchmark labor rates.

</details>


### [408] [Towards the Generalizability of Leveraging ChatGPT in APR via Self-enhancing: An Empirical Study](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.22844)
*Qingyuan Li,Chuanyi Li,Yaopeng Yang,Ziwen Ge,Jidong Ge,Bin Luo*

Main category: cs.SE

TL;DR: 该论文实证评估了三种ChatGPT增强型自动程序修复方法在三个基准上的稳定性，发现增强增益随基准和模型变化显著，跨基准泛化性不足。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: ChatGPT增强型APR（如自我纠正、自主代理）在Defects4J和SWE-bench上报告了强结果，但其增强增益在不同基准上的稳定性尚未被充分探索，可能存在跨基准泛化性问题。

Method: 在三个代表性长期基准上评估三种ChatGPT增强型APR方法。使用GPT-3.5-Turbo和GPT-5.4-mini两种模型，通过代码变换和基准特定微调探究基准相关因素，并对比直接提供错误消息与触发测试的策略。

Result: GPT-3.5-Turbo下，SRepair在HumanEval-Java上的绝对增益大于Defects4J；SRepair与无外部信息的FixAgent在BugsInPy上为负增益。GPT-5.4-mini下，各方法在Defects4J上增益更大，BugsInPy增益非负但有限。代码变换降低Defects4J增益，基准特定微调提升BugsInPy增益。直接提供错误消息与触发测试在BugsInPy上比增强方法产生更多正确修复。

Conclusion: 需使用多指标跨基准、跨模型评估泛化性；当增强方法增益有限时，直接提供修复相关的外部信息可能比增强方法更有效。

Abstract: Automated Program Repair (APR) increasingly relies on Large Language Models (LLMs). ChatGPT-enhanced APR uses techniques such as self-correction and autonomous agents to improve repair without modifying model parameters. Although these approaches report strong results on Defects4J and SWE-bench, the stability of enhancement gains across benchmarks remains under-explored. We evaluate three ChatGPT-enhanced APR methods on three representative, long-standing benchmarks. With GPT-3.5-Turbo, SRepair achieves a larger absolute gain on HumanEval-Java than on Defects4J, while SRepair and FixAgent without extrinsic information yield negative gains on BugsInPy. With GPT-5.4-mini, the evaluated methods achieve larger absolute gains on Defects4J than on HumanEval-Java, while gains on BugsInPy are non-negative but limited. We investigate benchmark-related factors through code transformations and benchmark-specific fine-tuning. Code transformations reduce enhancement gains on Defects4J, while benchmark-specific fine-tuning increases gains on BugsInPy. Directly supplying GPT-3.5-Turbo with error messages and triggering tests yields more correct repairs than the evaluated ChatGPT-enhanced APR methods on BugsInPy. These findings highlight the need to evaluate generalizability across benchmarks and models using multiple metrics, and suggest that directly providing repair-specific extrinsic information may be more effective than enhancement methods when their gains are limited.

</details>


### [409] ["It Comes in Notebooks": Changes and Challenges when Operationalizing ML Prototypes](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.22903)
*Arumoy Shome,Luís Cruz,Diomidis Spinellis,Arie van Deursen*

Main category: cs.SE

TL;DR: 通过对13位ML从业者的访谈，归纳出23项工程改动（5大主题）和20项软件质量属性，提出“监督债务”概念解释笔记本到生产的过渡本质。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: ML从业者常在计算笔记本中做原型，再迁移到自动化生产系统，但这一过渡中的具体工程工作及其背后的软件质量关切尚未被充分刻画。

Method: 对来自工业界与学术界的13位ML从业者进行半结构化访谈，采用反思性主题分析（reflexive thematic analysis）。

Result: 识别出归为5大主题的23项工程改动（代码重构、数据流水线开发、测试与验证、流水线自动化、监控与可观测性）；梳理出20项覆盖ML开发生命周期的软件质量属性并映射到工程改动；揭示7项质量权衡；提出“监督债务”概念——笔记本将监督外化给人类，运营化即为偿还该债务。

Conclusion: 运营化不是简单重构笔记本代码，而是为笔记本提供的交互式监督构建自动化替代品；质量权衡是笔记本到生产过渡的内在属性，而非工程实践不良的症状。研究为从业者、工具设计者和研究者提供启示。

Abstract: Machine learning practitioners commonly prototype models in computational notebooks before transitioning them to automated production systems. Despite its prevalence, the concrete engineering work involved in this transition and the software quality concerns that motivate it remain insufficiently characterized. We report on a qualitative study based on semi-structured interviews with 13 ML practitioners from industry and academia. Using reflexive thematic analysis, we identify 23 engineering changes organized into five themes: code restructuring, data pipeline development, testing & validation, pipeline automation, and monitoring & observability. We also identify 20 software quality attributes across the ML development lifecycle and map them to the engineering changes. A recurring pattern in our findings is that computational notebooks externalize oversight to the human practitioner, and defer costs that become obligatory at operationalization time. Operationalization constitutes the repayment of this technical debt accumulated during prototyping, which we refer to as oversight debt. Practitioners do not merely restructure notebook code, but repay this debt by constructing automated substitutes for the interactive oversight that notebooks provide. We further present seven quality trade-offs showing that these tensions are properties of the notebook-to-production transition, rather than symptoms of poor engineering practice. Our findings structure operationalization effort, establish empirical links between engineering changes and software quality concerns, and provide implications for practitioners, tool designers, and researchers working on ML-enabled software systems.

</details>


### [410] [Characterizing Feedback Statements in Machine Learning Jupyter Notebooks](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.22912)
*Arumoy Shome,Lu\is Cruz,Diomidis Spinellis,Arie van Deursen*

Main category: cs.SE

TL;DR: 论文研究ML Jupyter notebook中用于捕获"静默失败"的反馈语句（探索性与验证性），挖掘29.7万notebook提取109万条语句，抽样816条建立分类法，揭示反馈以探索为主、平台差异显著，并提出notebook源文件应视为混杂因素。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: ML开发在notebook中迭代进行，依赖反馈驱动。许多ML失败不抛异常，无法被现有基于崩溃（crash-based）的分析捕获。作者希望了解开发者检查什么来发现这些静默失败，即编码了开发者心智模型的反馈语句。

Method: 从GitHub和Kaggle挖掘297,851个公开Python Jupyter notebook，提取1,092,780条反馈语句。基于CodeBERT嵌入做语义聚类，按比例分层抽样816条，采用扎根理论和开放编码对每条语句标注分析，构建分类法。

Result: 提出反馈语句分类法，沿"功能意图"和"ML流水线阶段"两个维度组织。发现反馈绝大多数为探索性；GitHub与Kaggle呈现质上不同的ML工作模式；将其与已有崩溃分类法映射，显示该分类法能捕获崩溃分析无法观察到的、针对静默失败的防御实践。

Conclusion: notebook源码应被视为ML开发者实践研究中的混杂因素；研究揭示了notebook工具化的机会，并推动对静默ML失败的经验研究。作者公开109万条反馈语句语料库和编码手册以支持复现与工具研究。

Abstract: Machine learning development in Jupyter notebooks is iterative and feedback-driven. Practitioners author statements that reveal information about program execution and use it to decide what to do next. We call these feedback statements and identify two forms: exploratory statements that display values for visual inspection, and validation statements that enforce conditions programmatically through assertions. Many ML failures do not surface as exceptions and thus escape the crash-based analyses that dominate prior work on ML notebooks. This study examines what practitioners check to catch failures that would otherwise pass silently, by characterizing feedback statements that encode the practitioner's mental model of what the code should do and what could go wrong. We mine 297,851 public Python Jupyter notebooks from GitHub and Kaggle and extract 1,092,780 feedback statements. We sample 816 statements through proportional stratified sampling from semantic clusters obtained from CodeBERT embeddings, and apply grounded theory and open coding to label and analyze each one. We contribute a taxonomy of feedback statements in ML notebooks, organized along the functional intent of the statement and the ML pipeline stage in which it appears. The taxonomy reveals that feedback is overwhelmingly exploratory, and that the two platforms host qualitatively different modes of ML work. Mapping our taxonomy to an existing crash taxonomy shows that it captures defensive practices against silent failures that crash analysis cannot observe. Our findings indicate that notebook source should be treated as a confounder in studies of ML developer practice, surface opportunities for notebook tooling, and motivate empirical study of silent ML failures. We release the corpus of 1,092,780 feedback statements and the codebook to support replication and tooling research.

</details>


### [411] [NostrAgent: A Decentralized Identity and Delegation Architecture for Sovereign Agentic Systems](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.22944)
*Oliver Aleksander Larsen,Mahyar Tourchi Moghaddam*

Main category: cs.SE

TL;DR: NostrAgent 是一个基于 Nostr 中继的去中心化架构，用三种自定义事件类型统一了自治 AI 代理的身份、授权、信任、发现与支付五项能力，实现操作者主权、可离线验证的授权与 L402 支付绑定，并通过原型多方法评估验证其可行性与性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 自治 AI 代理日益跨组织边界行动（调用第三方服务、代理间委派、付费使用计量资源），安全部署需要身份、范围委派、同伴信任、发现和支付五项能力。现有方案要么依赖中心化权威，要么仅覆盖部分能力，导致在密钥轮换或委派撤销时权威、信任与支付发生断裂——而这正是自治需要连续性的关键点。

Method: 提出 NostrAgent 去中心化架构，基于 Nostr 中继用三种自定义事件类型：Kind 38100 身份声明（BIP340 Schnorr 签名认证，含预轮换承诺）、Kind 38101 范围委派链（每一跳可验证地收窄授权能力）、Kind 38102 同伴见证（形成抑制女巫攻击的信任图），并用 Lightning HTTP 402（L402）将支付绑定到代理身份。评估采用 Python 原型与混合方法：ATAM 质量分析、两轮 mini-Delphi 专家小组、跨三个信任边界的 STRIDE 威胁建模、11 项基准测试（非参数统计）及 19 项失效模式。

Result: 离线验证达到亚毫秒级，委派链具备线性扩展性，regtest 上 Lightning 结算的 L402 中位延迟为 157 ms。19 项失效模式中 17 项通过实证验证，1 项经解析界定，1 项作为架构局限公开披露。

Conclusion: NostrAgent 展示了一种无需中心化信任根、可审计的代理系统原型基底，为构建可信的自主代理系统提供了可行方案。

Abstract: Autonomous AI agents increasingly act across organizational boundaries on behalf of human operators: they invoke third-party services, delegate subtasks to other agents, and pay for metered resources. Deploying such agents safely requires five capabilities that today live in separate systems: persistent identity, scoped delegation, peer trust, discovery, and payment. Existing approaches root these in centralized authorities or cover only subsets, so authority, trust, and payment fracture exactly where autonomy needs continuity: when a key rotates or a delegation must be revoked. We present NostrAgent, a decentralized architecture that unifies all five over Nostr relays using three custom event kinds: Kind 38100 identity declarations authenticated by BIP340 Schnorr signatures with pre-rotation commitments, Kind 38101 scoped delegation chains whose every hop verifiably narrows granted capabilities, and Kind 38102 peer attestations forming a Sybil-deterrent trust graph, with Lightning HTTP 402 (L402) binding payment to agent identity. Identity remains operator-sovereign without any registration authority; relays are substitutable transport rather than a trust root; and every authorization decision is replayable offline from signed events. We evaluate a Python prototype with a mixed-method design: ATAM quality analysis with a two-round mini-Delphi panel, STRIDE threat modeling across three trust boundaries, eleven benchmarks with non-parametric statistics, and 19 failure modes. Results show sub-millisecond offline verification, linear delegation-chain scaling, and Lightning-settled L402 at 157 ms median on regtest. 17 of 19 failure modes pass empirically, one is bounded analytically, and one is disclosed as an architectural limitation. NostrAgent demonstrates an auditable prototype substrate for trustworthy agentic systems without centralized trust roots.

</details>


### [412] [Diversity-Guided Search-Based Testing of Large Language Model Applications](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.23209)
*Lev Sorokin,Ivan Vasilev,Ken E. Friedl,Andrea Stocco*

Main category: cs.SE

TL;DR: 该论文提出一种基于搜索的LLM应用测试框架，将失败多样性作为显式优化目标，通过档案库维护+种群重生算子实现多样化测试生成。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: LLM应用易产生不准确、虚构或有害响应，且输入空间高维庞大，系统性测试困难；现有方法难以兼顾失败检测数量与失败类型多样性。

Method: 构建沿风格、内容、扰动维度的离散化搜索框架，维护生成测试档案库并奖励与档案库的距离；引入参数化重生算子（均匀采样/贪婪距离最大化）周期性替换非失败测试以维持探索。

Result: 在LLM安全、车载导航、车内功能控制三个案例研究（5个被测系统、8个LLM、18种配置、超百万次测试）中，所有引导式变体几乎均优于随机和组合搜索；多样化搜索失败数较少但覆盖更广的失败类型，贪婪重生算子取得最佳权衡。

Conclusion: 失败多样性作为显式优化目标可有效提升LLM应用测试的失败类型覆盖，而贪婪重生策略在失败检测与多样性之间提供了最佳平衡。

Abstract: Large Language Model (LLM)-based applications are increasingly deployed across domains including customer service, education, and mobility. These systems are prone to inaccurate, fictitious, or harmful responses, and their vast, high-dimensional input space makes systematic testing particularly challenging. In this paper, we present a search-based testing framework for LLM-based applications that incorporates failure diversity as an explicit optimization objective. Building on a discretization along stylistic, content-related, and perturbation dimensions, our framework maintains an archive of generated tests and rewards distance from that archive, while a repopulation operator periodically replaces non-failing tests in the population to sustain exploration. The repopulation operator is parameterized by its sampling strategy: replacement candidates are drawn either uniformly or by greedy distance maximization, two settings we compare empirically.
  We evaluate both against several baselines across three case studies---LLM safety, in-car navigation, and in-vehicle function control---covering five systems under test, eight LLMs, and 18 distinct test configurations, with over one million executed tests. Our results show that all guided variants detect substantially more failures than random and combinatorial search in nearly all configurations. Among them, diversified search detects fewer failures, but covers a broader range of failure types in all case studies, with greedy repopulation offering the best tradeoff.

</details>


### [413] [Specification Before Generation: A Pre-Registered, Five-Model Paired Evaluation of a Specification Frame for LLM-Generated Code in Money, Time, Idempotency, and Access Tasks](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.23270)
*Sandeep Dhuri*

Main category: cs.SE

TL;DR: 通过在提示中加入一段固定规格说明（267词），可显著降低大型语言模型生成后端代码的安全缺陷，五个模型全部受益。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: LLM生成代码的安全通过率四年几乎未提升，而受监管后端最关心资金运算、时间处理、重试安全与访问控制等缺陷；此前的指令文件研究未发现收益，因此需要检验更窄的"提示中携带规格说明"这一思路。

Method: 预注册假设、反驳条件、分析代码与一次性生成规则；用50个来自金融、医疗、保险的真实后端任务，测试五个厂商血统的五个前沿模型，每任务跑两次（裸提示 vs 前置267词规格框架）。用9个确定性AST检查器和不知情的Bandit安全扫描器独立评分。

Result: 规格框架使全部五个模型的缺陷下降（每任务平均减少0.16–0.70个发现，所有Holm校正符号检验显著，所有bootstrap置信区间不含零）；在有差异的对比中框架组100次赢95次，从未使任何模型在任何领域变差。Bandit在裸组发现53个中高危问题、框架组仅11个，方向对所有模型一致。模型无提示默认越弱，效果越大。

Conclusion: 在提示中加入固定规格说明能有效弥补模型自身缺乏的工程纪律，显著提升生成代码的安全性；全部500份输出、提示、检查器、评分代码与预注册均已带DOI公开，结果可被任何团队独立复现。

Abstract: Code generated by large language models passes security checks at a rate that has barely moved in four years. In regulated backends, the defect classes that matter most are money arithmetic, time handling, retry safety, and access control. Teams answer with instruction files, yet the largest controlled study of instruction files to date found no benefit. This paper tests a narrower idea: generated code improves when the prompt carries a specification, a fixed preamble stating what must be true of the result. We pre-registered hypotheses, refuters, analysis code, and a one-shot generation rule, then ran 50 realistic backend tasks from finance, healthcare, and insurance practice through five frontier models from five vendor lineages, each task twice: bare, and preceded by a 267-word filled specification frame. Nine deterministic AST-based checkers scored the outputs. The Bandit security scanner, which knows nothing of the frame, scored them independently. The frame reduced defects in all five models (mean reduction 0.16 to 0.70 findings per task, every Holm-adjusted sign test significant, every bootstrap confidence interval excluding zero). Where the arms differed, the frame arm won 95 of 100 times. It never made any model worse in any domain. Bandit found 53 medium-or-high issues in the bare arm and 11 in the frame arm, in the same direction for every model. The effect was largest where a model's unprompted defaults were weakest: the frame supplies the discipline a model lacks. All 500 outputs, prompts, checkers, scoring code, and the pre-registration are published with a DOI, so any team can re-derive the result without trusting the author.

</details>


### [414] [One to More, More to One: Category-Aware Iterative Expert Training for Software Engineering Agents](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.23377)
*Jie Zhao,Ziyu Jiang,Suhang Zheng,Minghui Shan,Xiaoxiao Xu,Lin Qu*

Main category: cs.SE

TL;DR: 提出类别感知的专家训练与策略整合框架，通过MOPD蒸馏多专家为学生模型，在Pro-618达58.04%、SWE-bench Multilingual达59.00%。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 仓库级SWE任务类别异构，池化智能体RL下各类别进展不均（有升有降），而聚合指标掩盖了这种"类别跷跷板"现象。

Method: 构建可执行任务与SWE Labeler多轴标注；分类别RL训练专家，交替Agentic-miniRL与Refresh-Repair-Expand；用标签路由多教师在线蒸馏(MOPD)整合专家，配ReLU门控奖励外推。全程无需外部模型提供轨迹。

Result: MOPD策略在Pro-618达58.04%、SWE-bench Multilingual达59.00%，较基座模型分别提升5.39和2.78个百分点；并通过最低类别提升与专家增益恢复评估。

Conclusion: 类别感知的专家训练与整合可缓解类别跷跷板问题，实现可部署单模型且无需外部教师轨迹。

Abstract: Repository-level software engineering (SWE) comprises heterogeneous task categories, whose progress under pooled agentic reinforcement learning can be uneven: gains in some categories coincide with regressions in others, while aggregate resolution obscures these changes. Motivated by this category see-saw, we develop a category-aware expert-training and policy-integration framework. Executable task construction and SWE Labeler, an evidence-grounded multi-axis labeling system, organize the training pools. Initial category-specific RL improves average training success while leaving uneven instance-level progress, motivating explicit consolidation of successful behavior and policy-adaptive task selection. Same-origin category experts alternate long-horizon Agentic-miniRL with Refresh-Repair-Expand (RRE): the updated policy refreshes instance mastery, reuses its own verified successful trajectories for Repair SFT, and reselects tasks for further RL. Label-routed multi-teacher on-policy distillation (MOPD) consolidates the experts into one deployable student, with ReLU-gated reward extrapolation keeping only each teacher's improving direction over the reference. Expert training and policy integration require no external model to provide solution trajectories or action targets. We evaluate Pooled RL and Balanced RL, expert development, and single-model integration through aggregate and per-category resolution, the minimum category lift over each joint-RL baseline, and expert-gain recovery. The final MOPD policy achieves mean resolution of 58.04% on Pro-618 and 59.00% on SWE-bench Multilingual, improving over the base model by 5.39 and 2.78 percentage points, respectively.

</details>


### [415] [Omni2Web: Benchmarking Audiovisual Website Development](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.23417)
*Minghao Han,Zhenghao Xing,Xize Cheng,Yuxuan Wang,Junming Lin,Ling Wang,Yinsong Yan,Yunfei Chu,Qize Yang,Jin Xu*

Main category: cs.SE

TL;DR: 提出Omni2Web双语基准（918实例、13907编辑步），含Direct Editing、Instruction Recovery、Instruction Utility三条轨道，评测17个模型，揭示多模态意图恢复与代码执行仍有巨大提升空间。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 屏幕录制的网页编辑请求含"this""there"等弱指示表达，其指代依赖语音、光标轨迹、页面状态与编辑历史，需超越现有基准所假设的显式规范进行意图恢复。

Method: 构建Omni2Web基准，定义互补三轨道：从录制直接编辑网页、恢复显式意图、测试恢复指令能否驱动固定代码执行器；评测17个开源与闭源模型，并进行步级分析与受控消融。

Result: 最佳模型Direct Editing EFS 51.17、Instruction Recovery IRS 49.14；固定执行器下最强恢复指令达51.08 EFS，远低于oracle指令的89.69 EFS。步级分析显示正确grounding不保证编辑成功，部分Omni模型恢复的指令比其直接编辑执行效果更好。消融验证时序对齐视听证据的价值，替换评判者仍保持排序。

Conclusion: 多模态意图恢复与代码执行存在显著提升空间，Omni重写器与编码模型配对的方案具有前景。

Abstract: Screen-recorded web editing requests contain weak deictic expressions such as ``this'' and ``there,'' whose referents depend on speech, cursor trajectories, page state, and edit history. Such requests require intent recovery beyond the explicit specifications assumed by many existing web-editing benchmarks. We introduce Omni2Web, a bilingual benchmark of 918 instances spanning 13,907 edit steps. It defines three complementary tracks: Direct Editing evaluates webpage editing from recordings, Instruction Recovery measures explicit intent recovery, and Instruction Utility tests whether recovered instructions can drive a fixed code executor. We evaluate 17 open- and closed-source models. The best models attain 51.17 on the Edit Fidelity Score (EFS) for Direct Editing and 49.14 on the Instruction Recovery Score (IRS); under the fixed executor, the strongest recovered instructions reach 51.08 EFS, still far below the 89.69 EFS obtained with oracle instructions. Step-level analyses show that correct grounding does not guarantee successful edits, while some Omni models recover instructions that the fixed coding model executes substantially better than their direct edits. Controlled ablations further demonstrate the value of temporally aligned audiovisual evidence, while alternative judges preserve the leader and broad ordering. Together, these findings reveal substantial headroom in multimodal intent recovery and code execution and highlight the promise of pairing Omni rewriters with coding models.

</details>


### [416] [VSpector: Specification-Driven Bug Detection for RISC-V CPUs](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.23517)
*Tianyu Jia,Zhaoyang Yu,Yuanliang Chen,Wei You,Jianjun Huang,Bin Liang*

Main category: cs.SE

TL;DR: VSpector是一种规范驱动的RISC-V CPU RTL缺陷检测流水线，利用官方自然语言规范而非人工构建的参考模型或属性，在CVA6与香山两款CPU上确认148个真实违规、对应73个缺陷（42个此前未知），精度达68.2%。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 检测开源RISC-V CPU RTL设计缺陷对系统可靠性至关重要，但传统方法依赖预定义的参考模型、形式化属性或定制缺陷模式等人工产物。本文希望直接利用官方自然语言RISC-V规范作为缺陷检测的信息源。

Method: VSpector采用四阶段流水线：规则提取、实现定位、候选识别、时序违规审计；通过分步上下文精炼方案，解决LLM使用中"上下文范围广"与"推理精度"之间的权衡，无需专门构建参考模型、形式化属性或定制缺陷模式。

Result: 在CVA6和香山两款工业级RISC-V CPU上评估，217个上报候选中人工确认148个真实违规（精度68.2%），对应73个不同缺陷，其中42个此前未知。对比实验中，SOTA CPU fuzzer DiveFuzz在每CPU 24小时运行中未检测到任何新缺陷。42个新缺陷全部已上报上游，开发者已修复19个并确认另外11个（共30个）。

Conclusion: 规范驱动审计是一种实用且互补的CPU缺陷检测策略，可有效发现传统fuzzer难以触及的缺陷。

Abstract: Detecting RTL design bugs in open-source RISC-V CPU implementations is critical for ensuring system reliability. Traditional detection approaches inherently rely on predefined artifacts. In this paper, we leverage the official,natural-language RISC-V specifications as an effective information source for bug detection. We present VSpector, a specification-driven bug detection pipeline that directly checks whether CPU register-transfer level (RTL) implementations adhere to official specification rules, without requiring specialized construction of reference models, formal properties, or custom bug patterns. To resolve the key technical trade-off between broad context scope and model reasoning accuracy when using Large Language Models (LLMs), VSpector employs a stepwise context refinement scheme across a four-stage pipeline: rule extraction, implementation localization, candidate identification, and sequential violation auditing. We evaluate VSpector on two industrial-strength RISC-V CPUs, CVA6 and XiangShan. Out of 217 reported candidates, manual inspection confirmed 148 true violations, representing a 68.2% precision. These violations correspond to 73 distinct bugs, including 42 previously unknown bugs. In our comparative experiments, DiveFuzz, a state-of-the-art CPU fuzzer, detected none of these new bugs during 24-hour runs per CPU. All 42 new bugs have been reported upstream, with developers already fixing 19 and confirming an additional 11 (30 in total), demonstrating that specification-driven auditing is a practical and complementary strategy for CPU bug detection.

</details>


### [417] [VibeMemBench: Evaluating Memory Systems for Coding Agents on Real Repository Coding Tasks](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.23570)
*Liyang Fan,Yingcheng Shi,Yongbin Li,Chenghao Sun,Xin Chen,Xander Xu,Hu Wei,Shiwen Ni,Min Yang,Jieping Ye*

Main category: cs.SE

TL;DR: 提出 VibeMemBench 基准，评测记忆系统在真实仓库编码任务中对可执行结果的作用，揭示仓库历史经验的价值与现有记忆系统交付能力之间的差距。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有评估无法说明记忆系统是否真正提升可执行的仓库编码任务：仓库基准测代码改动但不隔离记忆，记忆基准只测召回而不测下游编码结果。

Method: 构建 VibeMemBench，含 90 个 SWE-rebench V2 仓库的 111 个编码目标及 3,634 条历史轨迹；目标覆盖缺陷修复、功能请求、接口变更与配置工作，采用可执行测试判定任务解决。仅保留在参考设置下注入历史经验能提升可执行结果的目标，将冻结的已验证经验迁移至五个留出求解器，并让四个现有记忆系统自行构建与检索经验进行对比。

Result: 直接注入经验使四个求解器的任务解决率提升 1.1–4.5 个百分点，且五个求解器的智能体步数均下降；但由现有记忆系统自行构建和检索经验时，十二个"求解器-系统"组合中有十一个未能超过匹配的无记忆基线。

Conclusion: VibeMemBench 暴露了仓库历史中蕴含的有用经验与现有记忆系统实际交付的经验之间的鸿沟，表明当前记忆系统尚难以在仓库编码任务中有效利用经验。

Abstract: Coding agents operate on real repository coding tasks, and persistent memory systems promise to reuse experience across tasks. Yet existing evaluations do not show whether those systems improve executable repository work. Repository benchmarks test code changes but do not isolate memory, while memory benchmarks score recall without measuring downstream coding outcomes. We introduce VibeMemBench, a benchmark for evaluating memory systems on 111 coding targets from 90 SWE-rebench V2 repositories and 3,634 history trajectories from the target repositories. The targets follow the SWE benchmark style and cover bug fixes, feature requests, interface changes, and configuration work. An agent edits each target codebase under a declared memory condition. Executable tests decide task resolution. Each target is retained only when injected history experience improves its executable outcome in a reference setting, so every target carries a prior experience whose usefulness is verified by execution in that setting. The frozen verified experience is then transferred to five held-out solvers. Direct injection raises observed task resolution on four of them by 1.1 to 4.5 percentage points while lowering agent steps on all five. Yet when four existing memory systems must construct and retrieve experience from the same history, eleven of twelve solver and system pairings fail to exceed the matched memory-off baseline. VibeMemBench exposes the gap between the useful experience that repository history holds and the experience existing memory systems deliver for repository coding tasks.

</details>


### [418] [Packaged, But Not Portable: Why Conforming to the Agent Plugin Standard Is Rare, and Why Conforming Would Not Be Enough](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.23809)
*Tezan Sahu*

Main category: cs.SE

TL;DR: 论文构建了AgentPluginZoo语料库（68,072个插件包），评估Agent Plugins v1.0.0标准的采纳情况。发现仅6.2%通过验证，但差距很浅（96.6%缺少一个样板字段）；更深层问题在于标准强制客户端丢弃40.2%的字段，且81%的能力导出插件存在命名冲突而无解决方案。论文提出v1.1配置文件需增加四个概念以实现插件组合。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 编码代理插件已成为可安装的能力扩展形式，2026年7月24日Agent Plugins v1.0.0开放标准发布以统一插件布局。作者想回答从业者关心的两个问题：生态系统是否采纳该标准，以及即使插件符合标准，是否就足以与用户已安装的其他插件协同工作。

Method: 构建AgentPluginZoo——一个可追溯来源的语料库，涵盖30,655个仓库中的68,072个插件包，发布发现台账、评分代码与分析。基于该语料库评估标准的验证率、字段丢失情况及命名冲突，并据此提出模型设计。

Result: 仅6.2%的插件包通过验证，但差距浅（96.6%补一个样板字段即可加载）。40.2%能加载但标准要求客户端丢弃作者所写字段（多为插件内容声明）。81%的能力导出插件与其他插件重名，无命名空间或优先级规则决定应答者。

Conclusion: 社区标准化的是打包格式，而组合需要一个模型。论文提出该模型必须增加四个概念：限定能力标识、声明的能力表面、优先级规则和插件间关系，并将其作为同一标准的v1.1增量配置文件而非竞争标准。对从业者和标准演进者的建议是：符合性必须可观测才能普及。

Abstract: Coding agents are extended by plugins: installable bundles that ship skills, sub-agents, commands, hooks, and tool servers. On 24 July 2026, an open specification (Agent Plugins v1.0.0) standardised how such a bundle is laid out and described, so that one plugin could run on any agent. We ask the two questions a practitioner would ask of it: is the ecosystem adopting the standard, and if a plugin did conform, would that be enough to make it work alongside the other plugins a user has installed?
  We answer both by building AgentPluginZoo, a provenance-tracked corpus of 68,072 plugin bundles across 30,655 repositories, released with its discovery ledger, scoring code, and analysis. Only 6.2% validate, but the gap is shallow rather than structural: 96.6% would load after adding one missing boilerplate field. The real cost lands elsewhere. 40.2% would load while the specification obliges the client to discard fields their authors wrote, mostly declarations of what the plugin ships. Moreover, conformance settles nothing for the second question: 81% of capability-exporting bundles share a name with another plugin, with no namespace or precedence rule to decide which one answers.
  This paper argues the community standardised a packaging format when composition needs a model, names the four concepts such a model must add - qualified capability identity, a declared capability surface, a precedence rule, and inter-plugin relations - and shows they fit an additive v1.1 profile of the same specification rather than a competing standard. Recommendations follow for practitioners packaging extensions today and for the people evolving the standard, chief among them that conformance must be made observable before it can become common. The corpus and code are available at https://github.com/tezansahu/agentpluginzoo

</details>


### [419] [MCPGen: Benchmarking LLMs on Executable MCPWorkflow Development](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.23925)
*Yingxuan Yang,Jiaqi Liu,Lirui Guan,Jiaye Gao,Weiwen Liu,Weinan Zhang,Ying Wen*

Main category: cs.SE

TL;DR: 提出MCPGen基准，评估LLM生成MCP工作流的跨层一致性，发现重建强但端到端执行弱（≤57%），集成是主要瓶颈。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: LLM生成的工作流工件可能结构合理，但因工具实现、schema绑定或运行时执行不一致而失败；现有基准多孤立评估或依赖轨迹代理，无法判断工件能否端到端执行。

Method: 构建MCPGen，包含100个自包含MCP项目、16个应用领域，设三项诊断任务（工作流重建、工具创建、向后兼容扩展）；在单轮基础模型设置下评估11个LLM，通过静态分析、单元与集成测试、进程隔离端到端执行来检验。

Result: 工作流重建最高88.5%，但无一模型端到端执行成功超过57%；单工具单元测试通过率达63.8%，项目级集成成功不超过45%。

Conclusion: 即使孤立工具测试通过，集成仍是MCP工作流生成的主要瓶颈；正确性依赖图结构、工具实现、schema绑定与运行时布线的跨层一致性。

Abstract: We study whether LLMs can produce executable workflow artifacts that remain consistent across graph structure, tool implementation, schema bindings, and runtime wiring. In this setting, correctness depends on cross-layer consistency: a workflow may be structurally plausible, yet still fail because tool implementations, schema bindings, or runtime execution do not align. Existing benchmarks largely evaluate these capabilities in isolation or rely on trajectory-level proxies, leaving open whether generated workflow artifacts execute end-to-end. We introduce \textbf{MCPGen}, an executable benchmark for Model Context Protocol (MCP) workflow development. MCPGen contains 100 self-contained MCP projects across 16 application domains and evaluates three diagnostic tasks: workflow reconstruction, tool creation, and backward-compatible workflow extension. We evaluate 11 representative LLMs in a single-turn foundation-model setting, assessing generated artifacts through static analysis, unit and integration tests, and process-isolated end-to-end execution. Models reach 88.5\% on workflow reconstruction, but no model exceeds 57\% end-to-end execution success. Per-tool unit-test pass rates reach 63.8\%, while project-level integration success does not exceed 45\%, suggesting that integration remains a major bottleneck even when isolated tool tests pass.

</details>


### [420] [A Carbon-Aware Quantum Computing Framework for LCA-Driven Sustainability in Quantum Cloud Services](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.24224)
*Muhammad Umar,Nauman Arshad,Azeem Akbar,Arif Ali Khan*

Main category: cs.SE

TL;DR: 本文将碳感知量子计算(CQC)框架从平台级扩展到服务级，基于超导量子计算机的LCA实证结果，为量子云服务(QCS)提供商提供可操作指导。结果显示五年碳足迹583-10570 t CO2e，以隐含碳为主，重排了运营杠杆优先级。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 量子计算的环境足迹相对于经典基础设施研究不足；随着量子计算向云交付发展，QCS提供商缺乏平台级碳核算框架之外的可操作指导。

Method: 通过服务级隐含碳分配、负载无关与负载比例化的运营碳分解，以及基于超导量子平台从摇篮到坟墓LCA结果的工作负载解析应用抵消，建立服务级CQC模型。

Result: 五年碳足迹为583 t CO2e(GKP)和10,570 t(表面码)，隐含碳占77.3-85.2%；运营-隐含碳持平需17.0-28.7年，而经典对照仅2.7年。杠杆排序改变：利用率增益最大(19.7x)，其次为寿命延长(59.9%)和电力供应(6.5x)，运营效率与可再生采购杠杆有限。

Conclusion: 超导量子计算机在结构上由隐含碳主导，颠覆了经典可持续性直觉，并推动在量子基础设施扩展时进行直接功耗测量和跨架构验证。

Abstract: Quantum computing's environmental footprint remains poorly understood relative to classical infrastructure, and as quantum computing moves toward cloud delivery, Quantum Cloud Service (QCS) providers lack actionable guidance beyond platform-level carbon-accounting frameworks.
