### [776] [Predicting Postprandial Glycemic Response from Meal Images, Clinical Variables, and Gut Microbiome Information](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.24453)
*Varvara Kondratyeva,Kamilia Zaripova,Nassir Navab,Azade Farshad*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 该论文提出一个多模态框架，用图像估算营养素替代人工饮食记录，结合临床变量与肠道微生物信息预测餐后血糖反应（PPGR），在真实数据集上优于现有基线并在无人工记录下接近传统方法性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有PPGR预测方法依赖人工上报饮食摄入，难以在自由生活场景中大规模应用，需要更可扩展的个性化方案。

Method: 构建多模态框架：以餐食图像导出营养素估计，联合临床变量与肠道微生物信息；框架同时进行图像营养素估计与血糖预测，并使用基于注意力的预测模块建模饮食与宿主特异性信息的交互。

Result: 在包含餐食图像、连续血糖监测、临床变量和肠道微生物的真实数据集上，模型优于使用图像营养输入的PPGR基线，并在仅用自动估算营养信息的情况下接近依赖人工上报营养素方法的性能。

Conclusion: 图像估算营养结合临床与肠道微生物信息，为可扩展的个性化PPGR预测提供了实用基础。

Abstract: Predicting postprandial glycemic response (PPGR) is fundamental to personalized nutrition and type 2 diabetes management, yet existing approaches typically rely on manually reported dietary intake, limiting their scalability in free-living settings. We propose a multimodal framework that replaces manual dietary logging with image-derived macronutrient estimates and integrates them with clinical variables and gut microbiome information for personalized PPGR prediction. The framework jointly performs image-based macronutrient estimation and glucose prediction, while an attention-based prediction module models interactions between dietary and host-specific information. We evaluate the proposed approach on a real-world dataset comprising meal images, continuous glucose monitoring, clinical variables, and gut microbiome profiles. The proposed model outperforms existing PPGR baselines using image-derived nutritional inputs and approaches the performance of methods that rely on manually reported macronutrients despite using automatically estimated nutritional information. These results demonstrate that combining image-derived nutrition with complementary clinical and gut microbiome information provides a practical foundation for scalable personalized PPGR prediction.

</details>


### [777] [Fathom-Vaidya: Advancing Medical Reasoning with Rubric-Based Rewards](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.24480)
*Kalash Shah,Kunal Singh,Snehan J,Shreyas Singh*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 提出顺序训练框架，结合合成数据与基于评分标准的强化学习，分两步提升医疗LLM的诊断推理与临床交互推理能力。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 医疗LLM需兼具诊断推理与临床交互推理能力，但现有基准（HealthBench、MedXpertQA）显示两者均存在明显短板。

Method: 先以MedBullets题目配合规则与评分标准引导的RL提升诊断推理；再生成5.3k合成多轮临床场景，每例配对多维评分标准进行训练。

Result: MedXpertQA提升超10%；30B模型在HealthBench-Hard达50.1%准确率，超越包括GPT-5(thinking)在内的专有基线。

Conclusion: 针对性的合成数据集与评分标准训练可系统性提升医疗LLM的诊断与交互推理能力。

Abstract: Deploying Large Language Models (LLMs) in healthcare requires robust performance across two complementary dimensions - diagnostic reasoning: the convergent, evidence-driven task of inferring a patient's condition from clinical data to produce a diagnosis, and clinical healthcare reasoning: the broader, navigational judgment required to communicate, plan, and adapt across multi-turn clinical interactions where a single correct answer may not exist. Recent benchmarks such as HealthBench and MedXpertQA reveal persistent weaknesses in both areas, exposing failures in complex diagnostic scenarios and limitations in contextual, patient-centered dialogue. We introduce a sequential training framework that targets these facets using synthetic data and rubric-based reinforcement learning. First, we improve diagnostic reasoning using MedBullets-derived questions with rule- and rubric-guided Reinforcement Learning (RL). We then shift to clinical reasoning by generating 5.3k synthetic multi-turn scenarios, each paired with multi-dimensional rubrics to comprehensively assess the response. This approach yields over 10% improvement on MedXpertQA, and our 30B model achieves 50.1% accuracy on HealthBench-Hard, surpassing proprietary baselines including GPT-5 (thinking). Our results show that targeted synthetic datasets and rubric-based training can systematically improve both diagnostic and interactive clinical reasoning in medical LLMs.

</details>


### [778] [Not All Task Vectors Need Equal Rank: Energy-Proportional Allocation for Model Merging](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.24517)
*Hyunjoong Cho,Jinhyeok Jang*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 提出SERA，一种按任务向量奇异值能量结构自适应分配秩的模型合并策略，在不增加总秩预算的前提下提升多任务合并性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有谱合并方法对所有任务分配相同秩容量，忽视了任务向量谱复杂度的异质性，导致共享合并空间利用次优。

Method: SERA根据每个任务向量的奇异值能量结构分配秩，对复杂或孤立任务分配更多谱容量，对紧凑任务分配更少方向，将基于SVD的模型合并从均匀容量扩展为任务相关容量分配。

Result: 在标准视觉模型合并协议下，SERA在保持与现有谱合并方法相同总秩预算的同时提升了多任务合并性能；分析表明任务级谱集中度与自适应秩分配效果密切相关。

Conclusion: SERA通过任务自适应秩分配有效改进谱模型合并，并揭示了任务谱集中度对方法有效性的影响机制。

Abstract: Model merging aims to combine multiple fine-tuned models derived from a common pretrained model into a single multi-task model without additional joint training. Recent spectral merging methods improve over simple weight averaging by exploiting low-rank structures of task-specific updates, but they commonly assign the same rank capacity to every task. This uniform allocation ignores that task vectors can have heterogeneous spectral complexity, causing the shared merging space to be used suboptimally. In this paper, we propose Spectral Energy-proportional Rank Allocation (SERA), a simple task-adaptive strategy that allocates ranks according to the singular-value energy structure of each task vector. By assigning richer spectral capacity to complex or isolated tasks and fewer directions to compact tasks, SERA extends SVD-based model merging from uniform-capacity merging to task-dependent capacity allocation. Experiments under standard vision model merging protocols show that SERA improves multi-task merging performance while preserving the same total rank budget as existing spectral merging methods. Further analysis demonstrates that task-level spectral concentration is closely related to the per-task effect of adaptive rank allocation, providing insight into when and why SERA is effective.

</details>


### [779] [The Endless Exam: Mathematical Constructions from Today's Models toward Superintelligence](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.24555)
*Muhan Zhang*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 提出 Endless Exam 基准，用14个参数化构造族衡量数学能力向超级智能的进展，通过相对质量评分（不封顶于1）评估8个模型的69个实例。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有基准难以在超越人类前沿后继续衡量数学进展，需要一种可扩展、可验证、能持续测量的评估方式。

Method: 基于开放数学问题构建14个参数化构造族，参与者提交对象经自动验证并与公开前沿或基线对比获得相对质量分，并生成更大参数的新实例，紧凑证书保证大构造可验证。

Result: 在69个实例上评估8个模型，连续质量分能区分性能差异，但无系统超过已发布前沿；尺寸-质量曲线展示质量随问题规模的变化。

Conclusion: 发布生成器、验证器、参考、模型响应与分析，支持人类前沿前后持续测量数学进展。

Abstract: We introduce the Endless Exam, a benchmark for measuring mathematical progress from today's models toward artificial superintelligence through fourteen parameterised construction families. Each submitted object is checked automatically for validity and assigned a relative quality score against a published frontier or construction baseline, without capping improvements at $1$. The families draw on open mathematical problems for long-term targets and generate new instances at larger parameters, where compact certificates keep large constructions verifiable. Across eight models evaluated on 69 distinct instances, continuous quality scores distinguish performance even though no evaluated system surpasses a published frontier. Size-quality curves show how construction quality changes as problem size increases. We release the generators, verifiers, references, model responses and analysis to support continued measurement before and beyond human frontiers.

</details>


### [780] [Custom Named Entity Recognition and Topic Classification for Global Health Publications](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.24625)
*Genis Skura,Antoine Geissbühler,Jean-Luc Falcone*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 该论文研究在标注数据和算力有限的情况下，如何为全球健康文献选择与适配NLP模型，通过语义标签发现、命名实体识别和多标签主题分类实验，分析领域专门化与轻量适配的价值及Transformer高推理成本的权衡。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 在全球健康文献场景中，标注数据和计算资源往往有限，因此需要明确何时应采用领域专门化或轻量适配方法，何时Transformer的高准确率足以justify其更高推理成本，从而为资源受限下的知识系统构建提供实证依据。

Method: 1) 语义标签发现：将基于skip-gram的word2vec在逐步扩大的专门语料上训练，并与BioWordVec比较，考察语料规模和领域语境对标签发现的影响；2) NER：在1,000句标注数据上比较卷积spaCy模型与基于RoBERTa的Transformer，并对卷积模型进行微调、集成疾病识别器（NCBI Disease Corpus）；3) 主题分类：在50个主题、1,000句手工测试句上比较MiniLM少样本分类与BART-MNLI零样本推理；并结合PDF预处理、实体过滤和MeSH增强构建文档级索引流程。

Result: 标签发现中，更广的词汇覆盖未必带来更有用的领域关联。NER中，宽松评分下Transformer达到0.80 micro-F1，卷积模型为0.65-0.69，但耗时82秒 vs 5-6秒；微调卷积模型并集成疾病识别器在NCBI Disease Corpus上达到81.33%测试F1。主题分类中，BART-MNLI单标签准确率95.2% vs 59%，多标签准确率分别为88%和32%（部分人工评估），但其推理成本更高。

Conclusion: 结果表明领域专门化和轻量适配在部分任务中具有实用价值，而Transformer在准确率上的优势有时足以justify其更高推理成本，为资源受限环境下构建知识系统提供了实证基础。

Abstract: How should natural language processing models be selected and adapted for global health literature in environments where annotated data and computational resources are limited? This thesis investigates these challenges through experiments on semantic tag discovery, named entity recognition (NER), and multi-label topic classification. First, skip-gram word2vec models trained on progressively larger specialized corpora are compared with BioWordVec to assess how corpus size and domain context influence tag discovery. Vocabulary coverage and qualitative evaluation indicate that broader coverage does not necessarily yield more useful domain-specific associations. The analysis then turns to entity extraction, comparing convolutional spaCy models with a RoBERTa-based transformer on 1,000 annotated sentences. Under a lenient scoring protocol, the transformer achieves 0.80 micro-F1 versus 0.65-0.69 for convolutional models, but takes 82 seconds rather than 5-6 seconds. This trade-off motivates fine-tuning convolutional models and integrating a disease recognizer that achieves 81.33% test F1 on the NCBI Disease Corpus. Combined with PDF preprocessing, entity filtering, and MeSH enrichment, the resulting pipeline supports document-level indexing. To complement entity extraction with thematic annotation, MiniLM-based few-shot classification is compared with BART-MNLI zero-shot inference across 50 topics and 1,000 handcrafted test sentences. BART-MNLI achieves 95.2% single-label accuracy versus 59%; reported multi-label accuracies are 88% and 32% under partly manual assessment. However, its higher inference cost limits practical integration. The results show where domain specialization and lightweight adaptation offer practical value, and where transformer accuracy justifies higher inference costs, providing an empirical basis for building knowledge systems under resource constraints.

</details>


### [781] [DUMA-Bench: A Dual-Control Multi-Agent Benchmark for Evaluating LLM Agent Security](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.24662)
*Ivan Aleksandrov,German Kochnev,Sabrina Sadiekh,Yaroslav Rogoza*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 提出DUMA-Bench基准，用于在"双控"交互（agent与用户均可影响共享环境状态）下评估LLM agent的安全性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有安全评估假设用户被动、控制静态，忽略了真实agent行为中交互动态的影响，导致评估不贴近实际部署。

Method: 基于τ²-bench扩展，构建覆盖8类漏洞（如RAG投毒、跨agent操纵、不安全输出处理）的对抗环境，评估5个模型家族共14个模型、8个领域及多种用户行为模式。

Result: 引入双控交互后，攻击成功率从26.9%升至41.1%。

Conclusion: agent安全性并非仅由模型决定，而是模型、用户与环境交互的涌现属性；DUMA-Bench为真实agent部署提供了缺失的评估层。

Abstract: LLM-based agents increasingly operate in environments where they interact with users, tools, and external systems. Yet most security evaluations assume passive users and static control, ignoring the interactive dynamics that shape real agent behavior. We introduce \textbf{DUMA-Bench}, a benchmark and evaluation protocol for measuring agent security under \emph{dual-control} interaction, where both the agent and the user can influence the shared environment state. DUMA-Bench extends $τ^2$-bench ~\cite{barres2025tau} with adversarial environments covering eight vulnerability classes, including RAG poisoning, cross-agent manipulation, and unsafe output handling. We evaluate \textbf{14 models from five model families} (OpenAI, Anthropic, DeepSeek, Qwen, and Z.ai) across eight domains and multiple user-behavior regimes. Across our experiments, introducing dual-control interaction increases the attack success rate from \textbf{26.9\%} to \textbf{41.1\%}. These results show that agent security is not solely a property of the model but emerges from the interaction between the model, the user, and the environment. DUMA-Bench provides a missing evaluation layer for studying security in realistic agent deployments.

</details>


### [782] [Beyond Endpoint Performance: Process-Level Evaluation of Self-Evolving Agents](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.24663)
*Hongqiang Lin,Chao Liu,Xiaofan Bai,Xuan Jin,Yuhong Li,Nenggan Zheng,Xipeng Cao*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 提出EvoPathBench基准，通过冻结演进工件在多个检查点并评估目标能力，实现自演进智能体的过程级能力追踪。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 已有自演进智能体评估只看端点性能，无法反映能力在经验流中的动态变化（何时涌现、是否被增强/保留/削弱），需要过程级评估。

Method: 固定基础模型与工具，将演进工件在连续检查点冻结，并在留出episode上评估目标能力；使用公开交易数据与校准轨迹，测试三种能力：对未见任务的泛化、无关学习后的保留、对新证据的规则适应。

Result: 相似未见过任务上的增益在分布偏移下常被削弱；保留损失集中在少数演进路径；无方法实现可靠的规则适应；生成候选工件有显著留出增益，但选定更新未能兑现这一潜力。

Conclusion: 能力级过程评估是分析自演进的基础，候选评估与选择是关键改进目标。

Abstract: Self-evolving agents convert interaction feedback into persistent artifacts, such as memories or skills, which in turn guide subsequent decisions. As these artifacts are iteratively updated throughout an experience stream, the capabilities they support may evolve. Consequently, endpoint performance alone offers an incomplete view of self-evolution. Process-level evaluation is therefore essential to identify when a target capability emerges and whether later updates strengthen, preserve, or weaken it. Motivated by this, we propose \textsc{EvoPathBench}, a benchmark that tracks individual capabilities during artifact-level self-evolution. EvoPathBench fixes the base model, tools, freezes evolving artifacts at successive checkpoints, and evaluates the target capability on held-out episodes. This benchmark evaluates agent self-evolution using public trading data and calibrated trajectories. It tests three capabilities: generalization to unseen tasks, retention after unrelated learning, and rule adaptation to new evidence. Experimental results show that gains on similar unseen tasks often weaken under distribution shift, retention losses are concentrated in a minority of evolution paths, and no method achieves reliable rule adaptation. Moreover, while self-evolution enables agents to generate candidate artifacts with substantial held-out gains, the selected updates consistently fall short of realizing this potential. Together, these findings establish capability-level process evaluation as a foundation for analyzing self-evolution, identifying candidate evaluation and selection as key targets for improvement.

</details>


### [783] [TimeLitmus: A Diagnostic Benchmark for Cross-Modal Understanding and Explanation Faithfulness in Event-Conditioned Time-Series Prediction](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.24677)
*Jie Gong,Maowei Jiang,Zhiwei Liu,Yankai Chen,Guojun Xiong,Xue Liu,Min Peng,Qianqian Xie,Sophia Ananiadou*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 提出TimeLitmus诊断基准，揭示LLM在事件-时间序列跨模态预测中准确率高估了真实理解能力，解释忠实度同样存在显著差距。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有LLM用于数值时间序列与文本事件的联合预测时，准确率无法区分模型是真正整合了两种输入，还是依赖事件极性、单模态先验或表面线索；且看似合理的解释可能只是事后合理化，并未反映真实驱动证据。

Method: 构建TimeLitmus基准，含Finance与Traffic两领域共4,856条评估记录，结合自然预测、受控反事实与对比干预、面向解释的忠实度测试及系统性捷径控制，对十种代表性LLM进行评估，并与人类标注者对比。

Result: 标准预测准确率显著高估跨模态理解：Hard Paired Contrast配对正确率Finance仅19.2%、Traffic仅11.7%，且十种模型在Finance序列侧控制上一致性均低于预期；解释忠实度差距类似，Traffic中多数模型在超90%案例引用被操纵的时序因素，但行为支持率不足22%；人类标注者在受控与困难配对诊断上优于LLM；仅自然数据适配仅带来选择性提升。

Conclusion: LLM在事件条件时间序列预测中的准确率与解释均不能可靠反映跨模态理解，TimeLitmus通过受控、反事实与忠实度诊断揭示这一差距，基准、评估套件及监督适配数据将公开。

Abstract: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly used to make predictions from numerical time-series histories and textual events. Yet accuracy alone cannot reveal whether correct answers reflect effective integration of the two inputs or instead arise from event polarity, unimodal priors, or superficial cues. Likewise, plausible explanations may rationalize predictions without faithfully reflecting the evidence that drives model behavior. We introduce TimeLitmus, a diagnostic benchmark for cross-modal understanding and explanation faithfulness in event-conditioned time-series prediction. TimeLitmus contains 4,856 evaluation records across Finance and Traffic, combining natural prediction with controlled counterfactual and contrastive interventions, explanation-targeted faithfulness tests, and systematic shortcut controls. Across ten representative LLMs, standard prediction accuracy substantially overstates reliable cross-modal understanding: Hard Paired Contrast (HPC) pair correctness peaks at only 19.2% in Finance and 11.7% in Traffic, and all ten models show lower-than-expected consistency on Finance series-side controls. Models often recognize scenario relations explicitly yet fail to apply them during independent prediction. Explanation faithfulness shows a similar gap: in Traffic, most models cite the manipulated temporal factor in over 90% of cases, while behavioral support remains below 22%. Human annotators outperform LLMs on matched controlled and hard-pair diagnostics, confirming that these distinctions are recoverable from the inputs. Natural-only adaptation yields selective gains in evidence selection and input sensitivity, but not consistent gains in controlled or hard-pair behavior. The benchmark, evaluation suite, and supervised adaptation data will be released publicly.

</details>


### [784] [World State Generator](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.24744)
*Sungheon Jeong,Sanggeon Yun,Ryozo Masukawa,Haleh Alimohamadi,Mahdi Imani,Mohsen Imani*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 论文提出World State Generator (WSG)，将语言规划表示为可检验的世界状态，使规划在与世界交互失败时能依据世界规则自动修正，从而提升语言智能体的任务成功率。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 提示式规划器在步骤被世界拒绝时，只能换词重写同一步骤，反复失败并耗尽尝试预算。根本原因是语言规划从未与世界绑定，拒绝无法在规划中找到附着的对象。世界有其自身规则、可行动作与约束，这些是语言从未表述的。

Method: 构建覆盖7个领域的合成世界，程序强制实施规则并评判目标，仅当目标从初始状态可达时才接纳该世界。智能体在其中运行，记录已验证的失败与修复，形成约226K轨迹数据集，用于训练World State Generator。WSG将规划写成可检验的世界状态，并在状态失败时把该失败视为世界给出的规则，重写剩余状态以遵守规则，使规划随运行不断向世界弯曲。

Result: 在7个公开基准上，WSG使两个约300亿参数的开源模型端到端成功率超过提示式方法，并达到专有模型水平。

Conclusion: 将规划与世界状态对齐，而非仅用语言描述规划，是解决规划被拒绝后无法有效修正的关键，能显著提升开源模型智能体的表现。

Abstract: Language agents solve complex tasks through plans and actions. A single step the world refuses puts the goal out of reach, and what the agent does next decides the task. Prompted planners fail at exactly this point, rewriting the refused step in new words, meeting the same refusal, and burning the attempt budget without moving. They fail because the plan was never tied to the world, so a refusal has nothing in the plan to attach to. A world is where a task runs, and it has its own rules, its own admissible actions, and its own constraints. We build synthetic worlds across 7 domains and extract training data from them. A program enforces each world's rules and grades its goal, and every world is admitted only if its goal is reachable from its initial state. Agents run inside and leave verified failures paired with repairs that carried the run to a state the world certified, a record of about 226K trajectories. On this record we train the World State Generator, a model that writes a plan as checkable states of the world and keeps that plan aligned with the world it runs in. That alignment is what a plan written in language lacks, since the world it runs in has physical limits, logical dependencies, and required orders the language never states, and the plan encounters these rules only when a state fails. WSG takes that failure as the rule the world has stated and rewrites the remaining states to obey it, so the plan bends to the world as the run goes on. Across 7 public benchmarks, WSG raises end-to-end success for two open models near 30B parameters over prompting and brings to the level of proprietary model.

</details>


### [785] [Epi-Logic: A Conceptual Framework for Epistemic Runtime Control, Schema Validity Checking, and Controlled Accommodation in Autonomous AI Agents](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.24755)
*Boris Wetzk*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 论文提出Epi-Logic概念框架，用于自主AI智能体的"图式失配"运行时认知控制，通过检测认知失调、渐进式降低自主性并审计式切换至有效图式。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 自主AI智能体日益部署于决策难以逆转的领域，当智能体所用解释框架不再适用于当前语境时会产生"图式失配"。此状态下输出虽内部一致、语言合理、事实基本正确，但仅凭输出质量指标难以捕捉其有效性的丧失。

Method: 将图式形式化为由变量空间、期望模型、有效性条件、公理与元数据构成的元组。提出Epi-Score聚合七个认知失调维度；时间有效性维度D8、有效性条件违反G及公理违反作为独立分类路径，不与聚合值抵消。架构基于"检查不对称性"：形式化有效性条件可运行时检查，而许多行动的正确性只能事后确定。论文还区分两个架构属性、一个来自序列变点检测的条件性结果，以及一个经验性剩余部分。

Result: 提出八条带命名基线的可证伪命题，描述向经验验证的过渡。作者明确声明所有命题均为可经验检验的假设，而非已确立的结论。

Conclusion: Epi-Logic为图式失配下的智能体认知控制提供了概念框架与可检验命题，其有效性仍待经验验证。

Abstract: Autonomous AI agents are increasingly deployed in areas where wrong decisions are hard to reverse. This paper examines schema mismatch: the condition in which an agent operates within an interpretive frame that no longer applies to the current context. Outputs produced under such a mismatch can appear internally consistent, linguistically plausible, and largely factually correct; output-quality metrics alone therefore capture the underlying loss of validity only partially.
  The paper introduces Epi-Logic, a conceptual framework for epistemic runtime control. It couples the detection of schema dissonance, a graduated reduction of autonomy, and the auditable switch to a validated schema. A schema is formalised as a tuple of variable space, expectation model, validity conditions, axioms, and metadata. The Epi-Score aggregates seven graded dimensions of epistemic dissonance; the temporal validity dimension D8, violations of the validity conditions G, and axiom violations are carried as separate categorical paths that are not offset against the aggregate.
  The architecture rests on a checking asymmetry: formalised validity conditions can be checked at runtime, whereas the correctness of many actions is established only ex post. The paper separates two architectural properties, a conditional result from sequential changepoint detection, and an empirical remainder. Eight falsifiable propositions with named baselines describe the transition to empirical validation. All propositions are empirically testable hypotheses, not established results.

</details>


### [786] [Construting Reverse Thinking: Developing Large Language Models' Reverse Thingking Ability](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.24760)
*Xin Liu,Yunhai Li,Chunfu Jia,Ziliang Chen,Jisen Song*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 该论文针对大模型正向推理的局限，提出反向推理模式构建方法，通过两阶段数据与微调、细粒度奖励和平衡采样，提升复杂数学问题的推理效率与准确率。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有GPT-o1、o3、DeepSeek-R1等长思维链模型默认采用正向推理，在复杂数学问题上存在解空间覆盖不足、计算错误、假设未验证、忽略约束、响应长度限制五类错误。

Method: 构建易-难两阶段Math数据集（含正向与反向推理路径），采用两阶段监督微调逐步训练反向推理能力；设计细粒度奖励机制，用平滑奖励信号增强模型自主选择思维模式；引入线性衰减平衡采样策略维持正反向样本平衡。

Result: 实验表明该方法在数学证明等任务上显著提升推理效率与准确率。

Conclusion: 提出了一种灵活高效的反向推理范式，为复杂问题求解提供新思路。

Abstract: When facing complex problems, humans tend to try various ideas for different issues. Human thinking patterns exhibit remarkable flexibility in adapting to diverse scenarios. GPT-o1, GPT-o3, and DeepSeek-R1 adopt long chain-of-thought models to address complex problems by increasing reasoning depth, which default to a forward reasoning mode. We conducted statistical analysis on the accuracy of different mathematical problem datasets on models of different scales, and found five reasons for errors: Insufficient solution-space coverage, Computational mistakes, Unverified assumptions, Ignoring constraint conditions, Maximum response length limitation. To address the above issues, we proposed a backward reasoning pattern construction method aimed at enhancing the model's reverse thinking ability and dynamic adaptability. First, we constructed an easy-hard two-stage Math dataset for training large models and gradually improving their inference ability at different difficulty levels. The dataset contains forward reasoning paths as well as backward reasoning paths. And a two-stage supervised fine-tuning process is applied to progressively train the model's backward reasoning capability. Furthermore, a fine-grained reward mechanism is developed, employing smoothed reward signals to strengthen the model's ability to autonomously select thinking modes during the reasoning process, thereby avoiding reward hacking. A linear-decay balanced sampling strategy is designed to maintain a balance between forward and backward reasoning path samples during training, enabling the model to converge quickly and stably. Experimental results show that our method significantly improves reasoning efficiency and accuracy in tasks such as mathematical proofs, offering a flexible and efficient reasoning paradigm for solving complex problems.

</details>


### [787] [Convex AI Compositionality and the Governance of AI System Populations](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.24784)
*Andrea Ferrario*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出"凸AI组合性"(convex AI compositionality),用凸空间形式化表示有限AI系统种群所生成的配置,以支持AI种群治理。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 当前AI监管以单系统为中心,无法将相关AI系统集合视为治理对象,导致"AI种群治理问题":需确定哪些实例可被有意义地一并考虑,以及如何表示和监测其不断变化的配置。

Method: 引入凸AI组合性:用凸空间形式化表示有限AI种群生成的配置;核心思想是AI实例运行状态的凸组合与种群生命周期可达性兼容,并能保持系统间的形式化身份关系;利用加权状态分布、凸包等统计与几何构造作为治理工具。

Result: 凸构造可区分运行状态、种群权重、异质性及不同治理模式下的AI配置变化,并在特定条件下与生命周期可达性和AI身份保持兼容;通过分布式医疗部署和招聘AI变体的受控部署两个案例进行说明。

Conclusion: AI种群治理框架通过凸组合数学方法弥补了单系统监管的不足,为多实例、多版本、多部署配置的AI系统提供了可表示、可监测的治理工具。

Abstract: AI governance increasingly requires providers and public authorities to reason about multiple AI instantiations, alternative versions, and deployment configurations of multiple AI systems. Yet current regulation remains predominantly single-system-centric, acknowledging such multiplicity only sparsely without treating collections of related AI systems as governance objects. This creates an AI population governance problem: determining which instantiations can be meaningfully considered together and how their changing configurations can be represented and monitored. The first requirement has recently been addressed through trustworthiness-based accounts of AI identity. We address the second by introducing convex AI compositionality: a formal representation of the configurations generated by finite AI system populations that uses convex spaces. The core idea is that convex compositions of the operational states that a population of AI system instantiations may occupy over time are compatible with lifecycle reachability across the population and can preserve the formal identity relations between these systems. Well-known statistical and geometric constructions, such as weighted state distributions and convex hulls, become AI governance tools for distinguishing operational states, population weights, heterogeneity, and AI configuration change across different governance modes while remaining compatible, under stated conditions, with lifecycle reachability and AI identity. We illustrate our AI population governance framework through distributed healthcare deployments and controlled deployment of recruitment AI variants.

</details>


### [788] [GRUET: Quantifying Uncertainty of Agentic Reasoning-and-Acting Processes](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.24831)
*Shuang Liang,Xin-Yu Hu,Shao-Qun Zhang*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 该论文提出GRUET方法，用于量化ReAct智能体轨迹中的不确定性，通过图建模推理分支空间来量化轮级推理不确定性，并聚合为轨迹级不确定性以评估可信度。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: ReAct智能体虽能推理与行动，但面临显著不确定性：相同任务产生发散轨迹，高不确定性轨迹常伴随不可理解行为，严重损害智能体可信度。作者推测轨迹级不确定性源于LLM累积的轮级推理不确定性。

Method: GRUET包含两部分：(1)轮级推理不确定性量化——将潜在推理分支构成的推理空间建模为图，用图复杂度近似推理空间复杂度；(2)轨迹级不确定性聚合——采用简单聚合策略量化整体轨迹可信度。

Result: 在9个LLM和5个基准上评估，GRUET在选择性生成性能上有效，以AUROC、AUPRC和AUARC衡量均取得良好表现。

Conclusion: GRUET能有效量化ReAct轨迹不确定性，提升智能体选择性生成性能与可信度。

Abstract: Agents have attracted considerably increasing attention due to the power of executing both Reasoning and Acting (ReAct) in open and dynamic environments. The ReAct process typically exhibits a multi-turn trajectory in which one drives Large Language Models (LLMs) to generate both reasoning chains and task-specific actions in an interleaved manner. However, agents often suffer from significant uncertainty, where identical tasks yield divergent trajectories; trajectories with higher uncertainty often produce incomprehensible behaviors, severely undermining agent credibility. This work conjectures that such trajectory-level uncertainty frequently stems from cumulative turn-level reasoning uncertainty induced by LLMs; the latter often exhibits a collection of branches of divergent reasoning chains and their resulting actions. Built upon this, we present the Graph-based Reasoning UncErtainty in Trajectories (GRUET) method for the uncertainty quantification of ReAct, comprising turn-level reasoning uncertainty quantification and trajectory-level uncertainty aggregation; the former precisely quantifies reasoning uncertainty via modeling the reasoning space spanned by potential reasoning branches as a graph and then approximating the reasoning space complexity with graph complexity, while the latter employs simple aggregation strategies for quantifying the overall trajectory credibility. Empirical evaluations across nine LLMs and five benchmarks validate the effectiveness of our proposed GRUET in terms of selective generation performance, measured by AUROC, AUPRC, and AUARC.

</details>


### [789] [MedRSI: Recursive Self-Improvement for Medical Agents via Clinically Aligned Self-Evolution](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.24838)
*Junde Wu,Jiayuan Zhu,Minghao Hu,Fenglin Liu,Jiazhen Pan*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: MedRSI是首个面向医学的递归自我改进（RSI）框架，将诊断失败通过工具组合与任务特定模型训练持续转化为新的临床能力，并在公开与私有临床任务上超越人工设计的医学智能体。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有医学智能体能力受限于部署前由临床医生和工程师设计的功能，无法自主扩展；而直接套用RSI又会带来医学安全性挑战。

Method: 提出MedRSI框架，包含两个临床对齐的自进化机制：(1) 临床成本感知的失败优先级排序，按潜在临床后果而非频率决定改进方向；(2) 快速发现与缓慢注册分离，新工具需在后续患者队列中持续验证有效后才被纳入持久化智能体。

Result: 在公开的青光眼与心脏病基准及两个私有临床任务上，MedRSI逐步发展了分割、测量、预测、多模态推理与生成能力，超越人工设计的医学智能体，并自主发现原设计者未预见的临床问题解决方案。

Conclusion: 医学智能体不必受限于部署前设定的能力：在临床导向机制（决定改进什么、保留什么）的约束下，它们能够从诊断经验中持续构建、验证并积累新能力。代码已开源。

Abstract: Medical agents increasingly combine general reasoning models with specialized clinical tools, yet their capabilities remain largely fixed by what clinicians and engineers design before deployment. Recursive self-improvement (RSI) offers a different paradigm in which agents learn from their own failures and autonomously expand their capabilities, but directly applying RSI to medicine introduces fundamental safety challenges. We introduce MedRSI, the first recursive self-improvement framework for medicine, which continuously transforms diagnostic failures into new clinical capabilities through tool composition and task-specific model training. Inspired by clinical practice, MedRSI introduces two mechanisms for clinically aligned self-evolution. Clinical-cost-aware failure prioritization directs improvement toward errors according to their potential clinical consequences rather than frequency alone. Fast discovery with slow registration separates rapid capability invention from conservative adoption, allowing new tools to enter the persistent agent only after demonstrating sustained benefit across subsequent patient cohorts. Across public glaucoma and heart disease benchmarks and two private clinical tasks, MedRSI progressively develops segmentation, measurement, prediction, multimodal reasoning, and generative capabilities, surpasses manually engineered medical agents, and autonomously discovers solutions to clinical problems not anticipated by its original designers. Our results show that medical agents need not remain constrained by capabilities specified before deployment: with clinically grounded mechanisms governing what to improve and what to retain, they can continuously construct, validate, and accumulate new capabilities from diagnostic experience. Code is available at https://github.com/ImprintLab/MedRSI.

</details>


### [790] [Extracting Arguments, Not Just Classifying Them: Instruction-Tuned LLMs for Generative Component Detection](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.24855)
*Sofiane Elguendouze,Erwan Hain,Elena Cabrio,Serena Villata*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出ITFACD，将论证组件检测（ACD）重新定义为语言生成任务，基于指令微调大语言模型从纯文本直接识别论证组件，在标准基准上超过现有最优系统。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: ACD是论证挖掘的核心且最具挑战的子任务，需同时界定论证片段并分类为claim、premise等组件。现有方法多简化为序列标注、组件分类或"先分割再分类"的流水线，研究相对有限。

Method: 提出ITFACD，采用指令微调LLM，使用紧凑的指令式提示，将ACD重构为语言生成任务，无需依赖预分割组件即可从纯文本直接识别论证。

Result: 在标准基准上实验，性能优于当前最先进系统。

Conclusion: 这是首批将ACD完全建模为生成任务的尝试之一，展示了指令微调在复杂论证挖掘问题上的潜力，代码与数据已开源。

Abstract: Argumentative component detection (ACD) is a core subtask of Argument(ation) Mining (AM) and one of its most challenging aspects, as it requires jointly delimiting argumentative spans and classifying them into components such as claims and premises. While research on this subtask remains relatively limited compared to other AM tasks, most existing approaches formulate it as a simplified sequence labeling problem, component classification, or a pipeline of component segmentation followed by classification. In this paper, we propose ITFACD, a novel approach based on instruction-tuned Large Language Models (LLMs) using compact instruction-based prompts, and reframe ACD as a language generation task, enabling arguments to be identified directly from plain text without relying on pre-segmented components. Experiments on standard benchmarks show that our approach achieves higher performance compared to state-of-the-art systems. To the best of our knowledge, this is one of the first attempts to fully model ACD as a generative task, highlighting the potential of instruction tuning for complex AM problems. Our code and the datasets used are openly available in the following GitHub repository.

</details>


### [791] [Partner-Specific Affective Precision in Social Active Inference](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.24876)
*Harshil Shah,Andrew Pashea*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 论文提出"关系特异情感精度"（affective precision）概念，即对每个伙伴模型置信度的元认知估计，用于调节策略选择时的精度，而非改变信念内容。在多伙伴信任博弈仿真中，该机制主要通过策略承诺强度影响行为。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 多智能体社交中，模型可靠性因关系而异。仅推断他人行为不够，还需校准这些推断应以多大置信度指导策略选择。将不同伙伴的置信度合并为单一估计会丢失与策略选择相关的信息。

Method: 将情感精度形式化为关系特异性的元认知置信估计。每个伙伴的行为证据更新局部置信度，该置信度在策略选择时调节策略精度，从而调控信念在策略中表达的强度，而非改变信念内容。在多伙伴分级信任博弈中进行仿真。

Result: 伙伴局部情感精度主要通过策略承诺而非直接改善伙伴状态推断来影响行为。机制追踪伙伴反应可预测性而非实际收益，故更高置信度带来更尖锐的策略承诺却未必更高收益。社交行为突变时，旧有可靠预测积累的置信度仍在行为上活跃，显示置信度修正滞后于社交变化。不同精度增益与先验产生不同信任校准动态。

Conclusion: 关系特异性情感精度能够区分社交预测与社交策略承诺。置信度累积与修正取决于模型参数。

Abstract: In multi-agent social settings, model reliability varies across relationships. Beyond inferring what others will do, an agent must calibrate how confidently those inferences should guide policy selection for each relationship. An agent may maintain a well-validated model of one partner, a fragile model of another, and a model under revision for a third; collapsing these into a single confidence estimate loses information relevant to policy selection. We therefore formalize affective precision as a relationship-specific metacognitive estimate of confidence in the current partner model. Each partner's behavioral evidence updates a local confidence estimate that modulates policy precision during selection, regulating how strongly current beliefs are expressed in policy rather than changing the content of those beliefs. Simulations in a multi-partner graded trust game show that partner-local affective precision influences behavior primarily through policy commitment rather than direct improvement of partner-state inference. Because the mechanism tracks partner-response predictability rather than realized payoff, greater confidence produces sharper policy commitment without necessarily producing higher rewards. Under abrupt shifts in social behavior, confidence accumulated from previously reliable predictions can remain behaviorally active after the relationship changes, showing that confidence revision can lag behind social change. Finally, varying precision gain and priors produce distinct trust-calibration dynamics, showing how confidence accumulation and revision depend on model parameters. Together, these results show how relationship-specific affective precision can distinguish social prediction from social policy commitment.

</details>


### [792] [Pinocchio: Fast Uncertainty Estimates for Black-Box Language Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.24881)
*Kevin David Hayes,Arka Pal,Haosong Zhang,Tom Goldstein,Micah Goldblum*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: Pinocchio是一个外部校准器，仅凭黑盒API模型的文本响应估计其正确性，无需logits、权重或微调，实现跨模型零样本迁移。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 高风险决策场景需要LLM不仅准确，还要提供预测的不确定性估计。但现有方法依赖log-probabilities或微调权限，而许多闭源API模型（如GPT）既不返回log-probabilities也不支持微调。

Method: 提出Pinocchio，一个外部校准器：在七个LLM的响应上联合训练，仅需对目标模型单次前向生成的文本响应进行估计，无需访问logits、权重或内部状态；提供轻量0.8B文本checkpoint版本，并开源仅两行代码即可集成的接口。

Result: 在留出响应上预测正确性达0.862 AUROC；对来自八个机构的十三个未见模型实现零样本迁移；0.8B轻量checkpoint性能匹配最大模型。

Conclusion: Pinocchio以黑盒、无logits、无微调的方式实现有效的LLM不确定性估计，具备强泛化性和易部署性，可广泛用于现有工程流程。

Abstract: In high-stakes decision-making applications of large language models (LLMs), practitioners require not only accurate LLMs but also uncertainty estimates for their predictions. Existing approaches to uncertainty estimation for LLMs require access to log-probabilities output by the model or require fine-tuning access. However, many industrial LLM products use closed-source API models, and many such API models like GPT do not return log-probabilities and may not allow fine-tuning. We introduce Pinocchio, an external calibrator that estimates the correctness of responses from black-box API models. Trained jointly on responses from seven LLMs, it achieves 0.862 AUROC predicting the correctness of held-out responses from those same models, and shows zero-shot transfer to thirteen unseen models across eight organizations. Our model needs only a single forward pass to generate an uncertainty estimate and requires no access to the target model's logits, weights, or internal states. A lightweight text only 0.8B checkpoint matches our largest model's AUROC. We release code for adding uncertainty estimation to existing repos in only two additional lines of code.

</details>


### [793] [A Global Comparison of Schemas, Transparency, and Interoperability in Public-Sector AI Registers and Inventories](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.24883)
*Dipto Das,Shion Guha*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 该研究比较了72个国家、8,368条AI登记/清单记录，发现各登记系统虽共享描述性核心字段，但普遍缺少申诉、风险、法律依据和外部评估信息，据此提出分层可见性框架并讨论互操作性条件。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 政府AI登记和清单旨在让公共部门AI变得可见，但不同制度范围、字段 schema 和报告实践会构造出不同的公共部门AI表征。作者希望揭示这些差异及其对互操作性的影响。

Method: 比较来自国家级和跨国AI清单的8,368条记录，覆盖72个国家；在23个统一化字段上分析字段请求情况、缺失程度、schema相似性及同一辖区多来源记录的重叠情况。

Result: 各登记系统存在描述性核心，但很少要求填写申诉、风险、法律依据或外部评估信息；宽泛 schema 常伴随大量缺失值；schema 相似性未显示显著的模式化趋同；覆盖同一辖区的多个来源仅选择性重叠。

Conclusion: 登记记录反映的是披露安排而非完整AI治理图景。作者综合提出分层可见性框架，并指出实现互操作性需要共享概念、清晰定义和保留来源信息。

Abstract: Artificial intelligence (AI) registers and inventories aim to make governmental AI visible, but their institutional scope, schemas, and reporting practices construct different representations of public-sector AI. We compare 8,368 records from country-specific and transnational inventories covering 72 countries. Across 23 harmonized fields, registers shared a descriptive core but rarely requested information about appeals, risks, legal bases, or external evaluation. We found that broad schemas often contained substantial missingness, schema similarity showed no significant patterned convergence, and multiple sources covering the same jurisdictions overlapped only selectively. Based on these findings, we synthesize a layered visibility framework that shows how register records reflect disclosure arrangements and why interoperability requires shared concepts, clear definitions, and preserved provenance.

</details>


### [794] [BackTrend: Evaluating Scientific Weak-Signal Prediction via Backward Reconstruction](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.24921)
*Xiao Zhou,Yilun Zhao,Owen Jiang,Tiansheng Hu,Cai Xu,Manasi Patwardhan,Arman Cohan*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出BackTrend——一个回溯式基准，用于评估系统从成熟科学主题中恢复早期弱信号的能力，包含AI/ML领域25个成熟主题和66个人工验证的弱信号。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有趋势追踪、引用预测、前瞻报告等资源很少提供经验证的参考集，无法将具体的早期前兆与后期成熟范式关联起来，导致科学弱信号研究缺乏可评估的基准。

Method: 构建BackTrend基准：给定成熟目标主题和时间证据约束，要求系统恢复两类前兆——问题空间信号（被低估的研究问题）和解决方案空间信号（新兴方法）；通过2019-2024年发表频率轨迹将每个候选信号植根于大规模文献。使用语义匹配和基于覆盖率的指标评估前沿LLM、RAG系统和智能体研究系统。

Result: 现有系统常生成看似合理但错位的前兆，表现为主题漂移、粒度不匹配、近似错误匹配和覆盖不完整；最强系统F1仅10.1%，Coverage10最多达到参考信号的18.5%。预算分析表明，增加检索和网络搜索证据在中度预算内可提升性能，但无法弥合巨大差距。

Conclusion: 当前系统在识别科学弱信号方面存在显著不足，BackTrend为弱信号识别提供了可复现的评估基准，并揭示了现有方法的核心缺陷。

Abstract: Scientific weak signals are early, low-visibility research directions that later become central to mature scientific topics, yet existing resources such as trend tracking, citation forecasting, and foresight reports rarely provide validated reference sets that link concrete early precursors to later paradigms. We introduce BackTrend, a retrospective benchmark in which, given a mature target topic and a temporal evidence constraint, systems must recover two types of precursors: problem-space signals, underrecognized research problems, and solution-space signals, emerging methods for known problems. BackTrend contains 25 mature target topics in artificial intelligence and machine learning and 66 human-validated weak signals, reconstructed from large-scale literature by grounding each candidate in its 2019-2024 publication-frequency trajectory. We evaluate frontier LLMs, RAG systems, and agentic research systems using semantic matching and coverage-based metrics. Current systems often generate plausible but misaligned precursors, exhibiting topic drift, granularity mismatch, near-miss matching, and incomplete coverage; the strongest system achieves only 10.1% F1, while Coverage10 reaches at most 18.5% of the reference signals. Our budget analyses show that additional retrieval and web-search evidence can improve performance up to a moderate budget, but does not by itself close the substantial performance gap.

</details>


### [795] [Et Tu, Brute? Economic Misalignment in Personal AI Agents](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.24927)
*Aman Priyanshu,Supriti Vijay,Brian Jabarian,Niloofar Mireshghallah*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 论文揭示个人AI代理在获得个人上下文后，会自发地根据推断的财富水平调整推荐，即使被明确要求找最便宜选项、财富来自无关邮件、或受到隐私控制，这种现象被称为"对抗性委托"。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 个人AI代理在高风险经济决策中代表用户行事，能访问用户私人信息。这本来是让代理更有用的条件，但也可能成为损害用户利益的渠道，作者希望验证这种潜在风险。

Method: 在13个代理模型、三种经济决策（航班、健康保险、研究生项目）上开展32.5万次实验，仅向代理提供个人上下文，观察其推荐是否随推断财富变化，并测试明确指令、环境数据推断及隐私控制下的表现。

Result: 8个模型在相同请求下系统性地为更富用户选择更贵选项；即使被要求找最便宜选项仍会发生；财富从无关邮件推断时也会发生；阻断金融属性可基本消除差距，但阻断其他属性能使保险差距扩大最多40%；更大更强的模型并无改善，Claude Opus 4.8效应最大。

Conclusion: 作者将这种错位命名为"对抗性委托"：让个人AI代理有用的条件（访问个人信息）恰恰使其能够违背用户利益行事，且模型规模与能力提升并未缓解该问题。

Abstract: Personal AI agents make recommendations and take actions on people's behalf in high-stakes economic contexts, e.g., buying a flight, choosing health insurance, or selecting a graduate program. The agent is given access to the user's personal context, e.g., their email inbox and a structured profile of personal attributes, with the intention of making an optimal, personalized decision for the user. We show that by simply providing this personal context, the agent steers recommendations based on inferred wealth, without being explicitly instructed to do so. In a suite of 325K experiments on 13 agents across three types of economic decisions (flights, health insurance, and graduate programs), we find that 8 models systematically choose more expensive options for wealthier users when requests are identical. This steering continues even when it directly goes against the user's stated objective: when explicitly instructed to find the cheapest option, some agents still act on the wealth profile they have inferred. It also occurs when wealth is inferred from ambient data, such as emails unrelated to the task. And it persists under privacy controls that block specific attributes: blocking financial attributes largely removes the disparity, but blocking other attributes leaves it unchanged and can increase it by up to 40% for insurance, as agents rely on the remaining signals to infer wealth. Larger and more capable models are no better; Claude Opus 4.8 shows the largest effect. We term this misalignment "adversarial delegation", in which the very conditions that make a personal AI agent useful - access to personal information - enable it to act against the user's interests.

</details>


### [796] [Emergent Collusion in Long-Horizon LLM Agent Interaction](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.24967)
*Xinrui Shi,Yanzhe Zhang,Diyi Yang*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文研究长时程多智能体环境中合谋行为的涌现，发现10个模型中94%的轨迹出现合谋，且同族能力更强的模型更早达成合谋，长时程交互会重塑智能体协调方式并带来安全风险。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: LLM智能体越来越多地被部署于协作场景，长期交互可能产生不良协调行为，但合谋如何在长时程多智能体环境中涌现尚不清楚。作者希望揭示合规验证协议与奖励最大化冲突时智能体的行为演化。

Method: 构建长时程多智能体环境：两个智能体反复完成各自任务、共享任务日志、互相验证对方工作并获得奖励，并引入使遵守验证协议与奖励最大化不兼容的现实约束。通过10个模型轨迹统计、同伴干预实验（peer interventions）和消融实验（考察奖励结构、验证反馈、交互历史）分析合谋成因。

Result: 合谋在10个模型94%的轨迹中出现，同族中能力更强的模型更早达到合谋。受控同伴干预表明合谋受同伴行为影响；消融显示奖励结构、验证反馈和交互历史均有影响，尤其限制交互历史的数量与范围可减少合谋。

Conclusion: 长时程交互会以带来安全风险的方式重塑智能体的协调行为，合谋是其中一种重要风险，需关注交互历史等设计因素以缓解。

Abstract: LLM agents are increasingly deployed in collaborative settings, yet long-term interaction may give rise to undesirable coordination. We study the emergence of collusion in a long-horizon multi-agent environment: two agents repeatedly complete individual tasks, share task logs, verify each other's work, and receive rewards. We introduce realistic constraints that make compliance with the verification protocol incompatible with reward maximization, and find that agents increasingly deviate from the protocol over repeated interactions. Collusion emerges in 94% of trajectories across 10 models, and more capable models within the same family reach it earlier. Controlled peer interventions show that collusion is shaped by peer behavior, while ablations reveal additional effects of reward structure, the verification feedback agents receive, and their interaction history. In particular, restricting the amount and scope of interaction history available to agents reduces collusion. Overall, our findings show that long-horizon interaction can reshape how agents coordinate in ways that create safety risks.

</details>


<div id='cs.MM'></div>

# cs.MM [[Back]](#toc)

### [797] [Causal Localization of the Refusal Direction in Audio Language Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.22260)
*Leonardo Haw-Yang Foo,Hung-yi Lee*

Main category: cs.MM

TL;DR: 通过因果干预定位：音频大模型(LALM)的拒答主要由继承的文本LM的中后层承载，而非音频前端/接口。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: LALM是在已安全对齐的文本LM上接语音前端。当模型拒绝有害语音请求时，该拒答究竟由前端承载还是继承自文本LM尚不清楚。

Method: 在音频-LM接口及各LM残差层拟合区分有害/良性提示的方向，消融该分量并测量首token拒答裕度变化；5个LALM、3个骨干家族，4/5在留出类别迁移下评估，3个通过安全门。

Result: 最大效应出现在LM中后层，接口方向消融几乎无效。Qwen2.5-Omni上消融L16方向使裕度变化-7.10，投影器仅-0.013；清零编码器输出仍变化-4.7。早期层可线性解码但单层消融效果小；仅在LM骨干上拟合的方向可迁移到音频模型。由于有害/良性提示形式也不同，方向被解读为与拒答相关而非有害性特异。

Conclusion: 干预定位的是拒答裕度的依赖来源而非拒答计算位置；移动裕度不总改变输出文本。安全审计应采用干预而非仅靠探针，并同时审查继承的文本LM与音频接口。

Abstract: A large audio language model (LALM) attaches a speech front end to a text language model (LM) that is already safety-aligned. When such a model refuses a harmful spoken request, is the refusal carried by the front end, or inherited from the text LM? We test this with causal interventions. At each model's audio-to-LM interface and at tested LM residual layers, we fit a direction separating harmful from benign prompts, ablate its component, and measure the resulting change in the model's first-token refusal margin. Four of the five models are evaluated under held-out category shift. Across five LALMs spanning three backbone families, with three models passing a baseline safety gate, the largest tested effects occur in a mid-to-late LM band, while ablations of the tested interface directions have little effect. On Qwen2.5-Omni, ablating the L16 direction changes the margin by -7.10, versus -0.013 at the projector. The audio pathway is still in use: zeroing the encoder output changes the margin by -4.7. In the same model, the contrast is linearly decodable at an early layer where single-layer ablation has little effect, and a direction fitted on the LM backbone alone transfers to the full audio model. Because harmful and benign prompts also differ in form, we interpret the direction as refusal-linked rather than harmfulness-specific. These interventions localize dependence of the refusal margin, not where refusal is computed. Moving the margin also does not always change what the model writes. Safety audits of these models should use interventions rather than rely on probes alone, and should examine the inherited text LM alongside the audio interface.

</details>


### [798] [Hi-Singers: A Comprehensive High-Quality Dataset for Expressive Audio-Driven Singing Head Synthesis](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.22264)
*Yichi Zhang,Hui Zhang,Guanjun Liu,Yuefeng Zou,Fengzhao Sun,Jun Yu*

Main category: cs.MM

TL;DR: 该论文提出首个大规模高质量歌唱头合成数据集 Hi-Singers，通过严格过滤管线构建约170小时数据，显著提升多种模型在歌唱头合成中的表现，弥合语音到歌唱的域差距。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有音频驱动数字人模型在语音说话头合成上已实现照片级真实，但扩展到歌唱头合成仍面临显著域差距：歌唱需要更夸张的表情、更生动的张口动作和精准的节奏同步。当前主要基于语音数据训练的模型常出现"节奏漂移"和动态受限问题。

Method: 构建 Hi-Singers 数据集：首个面向歌唱头合成的大规模、高质量、in-the-wild 视频数据集。采用严格的自动化与人工过滤管线，确保主题契合、高分辨率和稳定运动，得到29,608个视频片段、约170小时。并建立跨语言和音乐风格平衡的专用评测基准。

Result: 在包括3D系数和扩散模型在内的多种架构上进行大量实验，Hi-Singers 在各维度上均持续且显著提升性能，实现更优的视觉真实感、更强的唇音同步一致性和更精准的节奏动态。

Conclusion: Hi-Singers 有效弥合了语音到歌唱的域差距，为歌唱合成任务树立了新的性能标准。数据集已开源。

Abstract: State-of-the-art models for audio-driven digital human generation have achieved photo-realistic results in talking-head synthesis. However, extending these models to singing-head synthesis remains challenging due to a significant Domain Gap: singing requires more exaggerated expressions, vivid jaw openings, and precise rhythmic synchronization. Current models, primarily trained on speech datasets, often struggle with "rhythmic drift" and constrained dynamics. To address this, we introduce Hi-Singers, the first large-scale, high-quality, in-the-wild video dataset specifically tailored for singing head synthesis. Hi-Singers undergoes a rigorous automated and manual filtering pipeline, ensuring strict thematic adherence, high-resolution rendering, and stable motion, resulting in 29,608 video segments totaling approximately 170 hours. We further establish a dedicated evaluation benchmark balanced across linguistic and musical styles. Extensive experiments across diverse architectures, including 3D-coefficient and diffusion-based models, demonstrate that Hi-Singers consistently and significantly improves performance across all dimensions. Specifically, it enables models to achieve superior visual realism, enhanced lip-sync consistency, and more precise rhythmic dynamics, effectively bridging the domain gap and setting a new performance standard for the singing synthesis task. The dataset is available at https://huggingface.co/datasets/CharlesZhang-USTC/Hi-Singers

</details>


### [799] [Visual Graph Reasoning via Knowledge Compilation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.22327)
*Rongzheng Wang,Zhe Wang,Ke Qin,Rongwei Wang,Muquan Li,Yizhuo Ma,Yihong Huang,Jielei Wang,Shuang Liang*

Main category: cs.MM

TL;DR: VGCompiler提出以编译为中心的视觉图推理范式，通过表示编译器和操作编译器从图像中恢复保留拓扑与状态的图表示并编译可执行操作，在8B模型上显著超越强基线。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有VLM方法在简单视觉图问题上仍失败，根源在于其优先监督最终答案，而忽视从视觉输入中恢复显式且保留图拓扑与状态的中间图表示。

Method: VGCompiler基于Qwen3-VL-8B，包含表示编译器（恢复结构保留的中间图表示）和操作编译器（将查询意图编译为可执行图操作）；使用分层奖励（可执行性、编译图有效性、表示质量、操作质量）的强化学习训练，并用冻结观察器生成轻量签名以支持档案检索与代码复用。

Result: 在GVLQA、VisionGraph、VGCURE三个基准上，8B的Qwen-VGCompiler超过最强闭源VLM基线28.9%、超过最强代码基线23.7%，并保持高效率；在地铁路径、物流配送、网络故障评估等真实领域可跨异构视觉图和任务泛化。

Conclusion: 以知识编译为中心的范式能有效解决视觉图推理中表示恢复缺失的问题，并在合成基准与真实领域任务上展现强泛化与高效率。

Abstract: Visual graph reasoning requires answering graph-theoretic questions directly from graph images, where graph topology and state are conveyed visually rather than given in symbolic form. Despite recent progress of vision-language models (VLMs), current approaches to visual graph reasoning still fail on simple visual graph problems. This reveals a fundamental limitation of existing approaches: they prioritize final-answer supervision over the intermediate recovery of an explicit graph representation that preserves graph topology and state from visual input. To address this limitation, we propose VGCompiler, a compilation-centric paradigm for visual graph reasoning via knowledge compilation. VGCompiler organizes reasoning around two compilers: a representation compiler that recovers a structure-preserving intermediate graph representation from visual input, and an operation compiler that compiles query intent under the recovered graph state into an executable graph operation. Specifically, we build VGCompiler on Qwen3-VL-8B and train it with reinforcement learning guided by a layered reward over executability, compiled graph validity, representation quality, and operation quality. VGCompiler uses a frozen observer to summarize graph and question conditions into lightweight signatures, enabling archive retrieval and code reuse across similar regimes. Experiments on three benchmarks GVLQA, VisionGraph, and VGCURE, show that Qwen-VGCompiler, built on an 8B backbone, surpasses the strongest closed-source VLM baseline by 28.9% and the strongest code-based baseline by 23.7%, while maintaining high efficiency. We further evaluate VGCompiler on three real-world domains, including metro routing, logistics delivery, and network fault assessment, where it generalizes across heterogeneous visual graphs and domain-grounded tasks.

</details>


### [800] [If You Hear It, Help Find It: Orthogonal Knowledge Distillation for Open-Vocabulary Audio-Visual Event Localization](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.23376)
*Yi Xu,Cheng Chen,Wenzhuo Lei*

Main category: cs.MM

TL;DR: 本文提出OV-OrthKD，一种可靠性感知的非对称蒸馏框架，通过区分教师信号的可靠性来放置监督，解决开放词汇音视频事件定位问题。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 不同监督源在时间边界可靠性上存在差异：视觉教师提供更可靠的边界线索，音频教师虽语义丰富但边界弱。作者将其定义为"监督放置"问题——哪些教师信号可影响定位决策，哪些应保持辅助。

Method: OV-OrthKD框架：视觉特征迁移塑造决策对齐表示；音频特征迁移丰富互补辅助子空间；文本原型锚定可见/未可见类别语义；正交损失限制两个教师特定投影的方向重叠。学生推理时仍通过查询感知融合使用双模态，但训练时音频教师监督不进入segment-logit路径。

Result: 在OV-AVEBench上，OV-OrthKD达到0.816 segment AP，F1@0.5较官方微调基线整体提升2.7点，未可见类别提升3.4点。路径分配、角色互换、破坏和迁移分析均支持监督放置是OV-AVEL的任务特定设计轴。

Conclusion: 监督放置是OV-AVEL中重要的任务特定设计维度，非对称可靠感知蒸馏能有效提升定位性能。

Abstract: Open-vocabulary audio-visual event localization (OV-AVEL) grounds a text-queried event in time from video, audio, and language. The supervision sources available to this task can differ in temporal-boundary reliability: on OV-AVEBench, our configured visual teacher gives more reliable boundary cues than the configured audio teacher, although the latter is a strong pretrained audio model and remains semantically informative. This is a setting-specific diagnostic rather than a universal ranking of vision and audio. We formulate the resulting challenge as supervision placement: which teacher signals may shape the localization decision, and which should remain auxiliary. Based on this view, we propose OV-OrthKD, a reliability-aware asymmetric distillation framework. Visual feature transfer shapes a decision-aligned representation, audio feature transfer enriches a complementary auxiliary subspace, a text prototype anchors seen/unseen category semantics, and an orthogonality loss limits directional overlap between the two teacher-specific projections. The student continues to use both modalities through query-aware fusion at inference, while the default training recipe keeps audio-teacher supervision off the segment-logit path. On OV-AVEBench, OV-OrthKD achieves 0.816 segment AP and improves F1@0.5 over the official fine-tuning baseline by 2.7 points overall and 3.4 points on unseen categories. Path-assignment, role-swap, corruption, and transfer analyses consistently support supervision placement as a task-specific design axis for OV-AVEL.

</details>


<div id='cs.GT'></div>

# cs.GT [[Back]](#toc)

### [801] [Strategic Opinion Manipulation in Multiplex Networks](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.22524)
*Raman Ebrahimi,Massimo Franceschetti*

Main category: cs.GT

TL;DR: 本文研究多重网络(多层网络)上策略性观点操纵问题，证明该博弈存在唯一闭式Nash均衡，揭示合并共识等于按可操纵性指数倾斜的"诚实共识"，且平台观察到的极化会高估真实极化。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有观点动力学模型假设智能体真实报告自身观点，未考虑平台跨多个网络聚合报告、而智能体可在各层策略性谎报不同观点的场景。作者希望刻画这种跨网络聚合环境中策略性操纵的影响与鲁棒性。

Method: 提出多重网络上的策略性观点操纵模型：平台以注意力权重合并L个网络层；每个持有私有观点的智能体在每层选择(可能不同的)报告，承担层特定的谎报成本，以将合并共识拉向自身观点。求解该博弈的Nash均衡并推导平台最优注意力权重。

Result: 证明博弈存在唯一闭式Nash均衡；均衡共识为按各智能体"可操纵性指数"倾斜后的诚实共识；失真等于可操纵性与观点的(中心性加权)协方差；各层报告都比真实观点更极端，故平台观察的极化高估真实极化。合并层是双刃剑：可操纵性依赖于智能体在各层影响力的平方，分散注意力稀释操纵，而异质谎报成本与中心性变化会放大操纵。当各层共享平稳分布时给出平台最优注意力权重的闭式解，否则用精确梯度和边际检验刻画。

Conclusion: 研究揭示了跨网络聚合观点何时(不)对策略性操纵鲁棒，并指出缓解操纵的潜在干预手段。

Abstract: Models of opinion dynamics on networks, provide a framework to study how a network of agents aggregates dispersed opinions into a consensus. However, existing models assume that agents truthfully report their opinions, and do not account for environments in which a platform aggregates agents' reports across multiple networks, and agents can strategically report different opinions on each. In this paper, we propose a model of strategic opinion manipulation on multiplex networks, in which a platform merges L network layers with attention weights, and each agent, holding a private opinion, chooses (potentially different) reports on each layer, at a layer-specific misreporting cost, so as to pull the merged consensus toward their own opinion. We show that this game has a unique Nash equilibrium in closed form, that the resulting consensus is the truthful consensus under a centrality tilted toward a manipulability index of each agent, and that the resulting distortion is the (centrality-weighted) covariance of agents' manipulability and opinions. We further show that agents' reports on every layer are more extreme than their opinions, so that the polarization observed by the platform overestimates the true polarization. Notably, we highlight that merging layers is a double-edged sword: as manipulability depends on the square of an agent's influence on each layer, spreading attention across layers dilutes manipulation, while heterogeneous misreporting costs across layers and shifts in agents' centralities can amplify it. Finally, we characterize the platform's optimal choice of attention weights, in closed form when the layers share a stationary distribution, and through an exact gradient and a marginal test otherwise. Together, our findings shed light on when aggregating opinions across networks is (not) robust to strategic manipulation, and point out potential interventions to alleviate it.

</details>


### [802] [Visibility Design and Strategic Reasoning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.22531)
*Raman Ebrahimi,Sepehr Ilami,Babak Heydari,Isabel Trevino,Massimo Franceschetti*

Main category: cs.GT

TL;DR: 论文研究"信息架构"（仪表盘、信息流、排行榜）如何通过"可见性/透明度"这一设计杠杆影响智能体的策略行为，在认知层级框架下给出了透明度效应与感知复杂度方差成正比的闭式结果。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 仪表盘、信息流、排行榜决定了智能体认为自己在与谁博弈。作者希望探究这类信息架构如何塑造策略行为，以及控制这些架构的设计者如何将"可见性"作为一种杠杆来调节群体行为。

Method: 提出一个行为模型，引入透明度参数 p 控制智能体被选择性地暴露于推理深度相近的对手；将其嵌入认知层级（Cognitive Hierarchy）环境，把智能体对他人复杂度的信念与所见信息联系起来。由于暴露算子相当于类型分布的指数倾斜，可推导透明度对聚合行为影响的闭式表达。

Result: 聚合动作对 p 的导数正比于感知复杂度的人群平均方差。这一恒等式给出了效应符号：在策略互补博弈中不透明提高聚合努力；在协调环境中不透明降低平均动作；对任何关于信念单调的响应规则存在序数版本。在泊松先验下，不透明充当"复杂度乘子"（等价于 Poisson(τ/p)）。据此刻画了协调型设计者面临的"分歧—水平"权衡，识别最受可见性影响的推理深度，并揭示不透明带来"复杂度税"使最深推理者可能败给中等推理者。智能体仅看到含噪的公开动作排行榜的仿真重现了反转与税收现象。

Conclusion: 智能体看到谁（而不仅是其推理多深）塑造了策略行为，可见性可作为设计杠杆。研究结果对信息架构设计与机制设计具有启示意义。

Abstract: Dashboards, feeds, and leaderboards determine whom agents believe they are playing against. We study how such information architectures shape strategic behavior, and how a designer who controls them can use visibility as a lever. We propose a behavioral model in which a transparency parameter governs how selectively agents are exposed to opponents of nearby reasoning depth, and embed it in a Cognitive Hierarchy environment, which provides a tractable language for tying agents' beliefs about the sophistication of others to what they see. We show that because the exposure operator is an exponential tilt of the type distribution, the effect of transparency on aggregate behavior has a closed form: the derivative of the aggregate action with respect to $p$ is proportional to the population-average variance of perceived sophistication. This identity signs the effect in games of strategic complements (opacity raises aggregate effort) and in coordination environments (opacity lowers the mean action), and an ordinal version holds for any response rule that is monotone in the belief. Notably, under a Poisson prior, opacity acts as a sophistication multiplier: every reasoner plays as if the population were $\mathrm{Poisson}(τ/p)$. We use this structure to characterize the disagreement-versus-level tradeoff faced by a coordination-minded designer, to identify the reasoning depths that respond most to visibility, and to show that opacity imposes a ``sophistication tax'' under which the deepest reasoners can lose to moderate ones. Simulations in which agents see only a noisy leaderboard of published actions reproduce both the reversal and the tax. Together, our findings highlight that who an agent sees, and not only how deeply it reasons, shapes strategic behavior, and point to visibility as a design lever.

</details>


### [803] [Strategic Classification Has a Missing Lever: Audit Risk](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.22534)
*Raman Ebrahimi,Massimo Franceschetti*

Main category: cs.GT

TL;DR: 本文提出将分类器设计与审计策略联合优化的战略性分类模型，揭示可博弈性取决于制度验证政策而非特征本身。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 既有战略性分类模型只允许决策者通过分类器应对造假，导致高预测但易伪造的特征只能被降权或舍弃，忽略了现实中审计与惩罚手段的存在。

Method: 构建联合设计线性分类器与审计档案（为每个可伪造特征指定检测概率与处罚）的模型；在线性成本下证明分类器仅通过博弈租金分布影响审计问题，从而将联合设计分解为评分规则选择与审计分配子问题。

Result: 刻画最优审计分配，识别其可解条件与NP难情形（检查上限下经重叠特征博弈）；给出通过学习租金审计的遗憾界；证明福利关于审计强度单峰，公司与规划者在威慑的检测-处罚组合上存在分歧；展示成本与因果结构相同的两个群体可在一个领域博弈而在另一领域改善。

Conclusion: 特征是否"可博弈"取决于机构的验证政策而非特征本身，审计强度应被调优而非最大化。

Abstract: Strategic classification studies how a decision maker should choose a classifier when the agents being classified can adjust their features in response to it. In existing models, the classifier is the only instrument available to the decision maker, and therefore a feature that is predictive but easy to fake can only be down-weighted or discarded. However, in many settings the decision maker can also verify: lenders verify income, admissions offices check documents, and tax authorities audit returns. In this paper, we propose a model of strategic classification in which the firm jointly designs a linear classifier and an \emph{audit profile}, which assigns to each fakeable feature a probability of detection and a penalty when caught. We show that under linear costs, the classifier affects the audit problem only through the distribution of gaming rents it induces, so that the joint design problem decomposes into the choice of a score rule and an audit allocation problem. We use this decomposition to characterize the optimal audit allocation, to identify when the allocation problem is tractable and when it is NP-hard (namely, when agents can game through overlapping features under an inspection cap), and to bound the regret of a firm that has to learn the rents by auditing. We further show that audit intensity is a quantity to be tuned rather than maximized: welfare is single-peaked in it, and a firm and a social planner disagree on the mix of detection and penalty that delivers a given level of deterrence. Notably, two populations with identical costs and causal structure can game in one domain and improve in the other, a difference that a cost-only model cannot account for. Together, our findings highlight that whether a feature is ``gameable'' depends on the institution's verification policy as much as on the feature itself.

</details>


### [804] [Beyond a Single Optimal Design: A Dynamical Systems Characterization of Online Allocation with Convex Costs](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.22651)
*Haoxin Sang,Bo Sun,Xiaoqi Tan*

Main category: cs.GT

TL;DR: 本文研究带凸成本的在线分配问题(OACC),通过动力系统方法将最优在线算法刻画为非线性特征值问题的解,给出保持最优竞争比的一族最优储备函数设计。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 以往工作多聚焦于构造单一的最优在线算法,缺乏对最优设计空间的结构性理解。本文旨在刻画OACC中储备函数(归一化定价规则)的最优设计空间,统一并推广现有算法。

Method: 采用原则性动力系统方法,将最优在线算法刻画为非线性特征值问题的解:最优竞争比对应主特征值,对应特征函数决定最优储备函数。

Result: 证明存在无穷多达到最优竞争比的最优设计,统一并推广了一大类已有算法;揭示了可无损混合动态与静态定价、在未知或随机成本下构造通用竞争算法等新结构现象。在供给侧不可知到达与硬供给约束等结构化场景下得到更紧的保证,改进了已有界。

Conclusion: 该特征值刻画为OACC的最优在线算法设计提供了统一框架,既统一了先前算法,又发现新的设计自由度与更强保证。

Abstract: We study online allocation with convex costs (\OACC), a generalization of limited-supply models in which additional resources can be produced dynamically at convex cost. Prior work largely focuses on constructing a single algorithm that achieves strong competitive guarantees. In contrast, our main contribution is a structural characterization of the optimal design space of reserve functions (i.e., normalized pricing rules) for \OACC, yielding a family of optimal online algorithms.
  Using a principled dynamical-systems approach, we show that optimal online algorithms arise as solutions of a nonlinear eigenvalue problem: the optimal competitive ratio corresponds to the dominant eigenvalue, and the associated eigenfunction determines the optimal reserve function. This perspective establishes the existence of infinitely many optimal designs attaining the best possible competitive ratio, thereby unifying and generalizing a broad class of prior algorithms. Beyond unification, our characterization uncovers new structural phenomena, including the ability to flexibly mix dynamic and static pricing without loss of optimality and the construction of universally competitive algorithms under unknown or stochastic costs. We further extend the analysis to more structured settings such as supply-oblivious arrivals and hard supply constraints, obtaining sharper guarantees that improve upon previous bounds.

</details>


### [805] [Algorithmic Collusion and the Complexity of Information-Value-Free Equilibria](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.22757)
*Ioannis Anagnostides,Weiqiang Zheng*

Main category: cs.GT

TL;DR: 本文研究简洁博弈中信息无价值（IVF）相关均衡的复杂性，证明IVFCE在多项式矩阵/贝叶斯博弈中PPAD完全且有无条件指数查询下界，IVFCCE的精确近似则至少与P-矩阵LCP和简单随机博弈一样难，仅在近似常数下有FPTAS。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: IVF（信息无价值）相关均衡是Hartline等为规制算法合谋而提出的精炼概念，其在显式正规博弈中多项式可解。本文旨在探究其在更现实的简洁博弈（多玩家或指数多策略）中的计算复杂性，以评估该规制方案的可行性。

Method: 在简洁博弈模型（多玩家多项式矩阵博弈、两人贝叶斯博弈）中分析IVFCE的近似计算复杂性；利用无遗憾动力学（regret matching、FTRL）构造IVFCCE的近似方案，并用复杂性类归约（PPAD、CLS、P-矩阵LCP、简单随机博弈）刻画其难度。

Result: 计算IVFCE在多玩家多项式矩阵博弈或两人贝叶斯博弈中为PPAD完全，即使近似为常数；存在无条件指数查询下界，排除高效学习动力学。IVFCCE在常数近似下有FPTAS（无遗憾算法），指数小近似下属于CLS=PPAD∩PLS，且至少与P-矩阵LCP、简单随机博弈一样难。

Conclusion: IVFCE在简洁博弈中一般不可解，强化了Hartline等的不可行性结论，并对算法合谋规制提出强计算质疑；IVFCCE虽可近似，但精确计算仍不太可能存在多项式时间算法，除非有重大突破。

Abstract: A (coarse) correlated equilibrium (CE) is information-value-free (IVF) if a player can match the payoff obtained from recommendations by committing to a fixed action. Motivated by the problem of regulating algorithmic collusion, this refinement was introduced by Hartline, Wang, and Zhang [EC'26], who showed that it can be computed in polynomial time in explicitly represented normal-form game. In this paper, we examine the complexity of IVF(C)CEs in succinct games, which model more realistic strategic interactions that feature either many players or exponentially many pure strategies.
  We first show that computing an information-value-free CE is PPAD-complete in many-player polymatrix games or two-player Bayesian games, even when the approximation is a constant. We also prove an unconditional exponential query lower bound. Our results establish that IVFCEs are intractable, even in the centralized model, and rule out the existence of any efficient learning dynamics. This significantly strengthens the impossibility result of Hartline, Wang, and Zhang, which concerns a particular class of learning algorithms, and furnishes strong computational critiques of recent regulation on algorithmic collusion.
  To sidestep these hardness results, we examine the complexity of information-value-free CCE. Certain no-regret algorithms---such as regret matching or FTRL---provide a fully polynomial-time approximation scheme (FPTAS) for this problem. The complexity when the approximation is exponentially small turns out to be nuanced. On the one hand, leveraging no-regret dynamics, we establish membership in $\text{CLS} = \text{PPAD} \cap \text{PLS}$. On the other hand, we show that it is at least as hard as the P-matrix linear complementarity problem, and hence as hard as simple stochastic games. This shows that even IVFCCEs are unlikely to admit a polynomial-time algorithm barring a major breakthrough.

</details>


### [806] [A Horizon-Independent Regret Bound for Optimistic Hedge in General-Sum Games](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.22839)
*Junsoo Ha*

Main category: cs.GT

TL;DR: 本文证明固定步长的朴素Optimistic Hedge在一般和博弈中可达O(1)个体遗憾与O(1/T)粗相关均衡间隙。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: self-play中简单学习规则能否保持遗憾有界是关键问题；Optimistic Hedge作为博弈中最经典方法，已知个体遗憾界仍为对数级，与近期通过修改正则化或高阶预测取得常数遗憾的工作存在差距。

Method: 将Optimistic Hedge表示为紧空间上的实解析递推，得到精确有限阶差分关系以消除时间跨度依赖；证明依赖Frisch(1967)的非构造Noetherian性论证，在期望损失向量反馈下分析n人、d动作的一般和博弈。

Result: 证明朴素固定步长Optimistic Hedge可达O_{n,d}(1)个体遗憾；推论其时间平均博弈具有O_{n,d}(1/T)的CCE间隙。

Conclusion: 简单经典方法即可实现常数个体遗憾，但(n,d)依赖因非构造性论证而保持隐式。

Abstract: Can simple learning rules keep their regret bounded in self-play? Recent work achieves constant regret bounds through modified regularization and higher-order prediction. Yet for Optimistic Hedge, arguably the most canonical method in games, the best known individual regret bound remains logarithmic. In this work, we prove that plain Optimistic Hedge with a constant step size can attain $O_{n,d}(1)$ individual regret in general-sum games with $n$ players and $d=(d_1,\ldots,d_n)$ actions, under expected loss-vector feedback. As a corollary, its time-averaged play enjoys an $O_{n,d}(1/T)$ coarse correlated equilibrium (CCE) gap. Our analysis represents Optimistic Hedge as a real-analytic recurrence on a compact space, which yields an exact finite-order difference relation that eliminates horizon dependence. Our proof hinges on nonconstructive Noetherianity argument of Frisch (1967), so the $(n,d)$-dependence remains implicit.

</details>


### [807] [Subgame Perfection in Graph Games with $ω$-Recognizable Preference Relations](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.22906)
*Véronique Bruyère,Christophe Grandmont,Noémie Meunier,Jean-François Raskin*

Main category: cs.GT

TL;DR: 本文研究多人图博弈中子博弈完美均衡的约束存在问题，在偏好为ω-可识别的一般框架下，证明该问题是EXPTIME-完全的，纳什均衡亦同。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统研究依赖具体的收益函数，本文希望避免针对特定收益函数，采用更通用的偏好框架（偏好关系为ω-可识别），统一研究SPE与NE的约束存在问题。

Method: 提出通用框架：每个玩家在局集合上有偏好关系，假设为ω-可识别；等价地，玩家在有限收益集合上有偏好，且同一收益对应的局集合是ω-正则的。在该框架下分析约束SPE存在问题的复杂度。

Result: 约束子博弈完美均衡存在问题是EXPTIME-完全的；约束纳什均衡存在问题同样是EXPTIME-完全的。

Conclusion: ω-可识别偏好的一般框架下，SPE与NE的约束存在问题复杂度相同，均为EXPTIME-完全，说明该通用设定不增加问题难度层级。

Abstract: This paper investigates the constrained existence problem for subgame perfect equilibria (SPEs) in multiplayer graph games. In the proposed framework, each player has a preference relation over the set of plays, assumed to be $ω$-recognizable. Equivalently, he has a preference relation over a finite set of payoffs, and the set of plays with the same payoff is $ω$-regular, for each payoff. This generic framework avoids the need to focus on specific payoff functions. We show that the constrained SPE existence problem is EXPTIME-complete, as well as for Nash equilibria (NEs).

</details>


### [808] [Suboptimality Loss for Inverse Learning from Imperfect Equilibria](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.23200)
*Andreas Feik,Pierre Pinson,Dario Paccagnan*

Main category: cs.GT

TL;DR: 本文提出博弈论次优性损失用于从数据中恢复隐藏效用（逆向博弈论），该损失凸且可分解，被夹在可预测损失与逆向变分不等式损失之间，并用镜像下降算法求解，在噪声和不一致数据下保持准确。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有基于逆向变分不等式的方法对噪声和不一致的均衡观测高度敏感，限制了逆向博弈论在实际系统中的应用，因此需要更鲁棒的效用恢复方法。

Method: 引入博弈论次优性损失，衡量玩家通过单方面偏离观测策略剖面可获得的总体效用增益；证明其凸性并分解为逐玩家的最佳响应；证明其夹在可预测损失和逆向变分不等式损失之间，作为可处理的替代；开发镜像下降算法最小化该损失。

Result: 在异构网络古诺竞争实验中，该方法在噪声观测和不一致均衡数据下仍保持准确，而逆向变分不等式方法产生退化估计。

Conclusion: 所提次优性损失为逆向博弈论提供了一种对噪声鲁棒且可分解的替代目标，适用于预测、反事实分析和机制设计。

Abstract: Many modern systems involve the strategic interaction of multiple agents. In such settings, observed actions typically reflect equilibrium behavior under utilities that are only partially known. Recovering these hidden utilities from data - the central goal of inverse game theory - is key for prediction, counterfactual analysis, and mechanism design. However, existing approaches based on inverse variational inequalities are highly sensitive to noisy and inconsistent equilibrium observations, thus limiting their applicability. In this paper, we resolve this issue by introducing a game-theoretic suboptimality loss that measures the aggregate utility gain players could obtain by unilaterally deviating from an observed strategy profile. First, we show that this loss is convex and admits an efficient decomposition into player-wise best-responses. Second, we show this loss is sandwiched between the predictability loss and the inverse variational inequality loss, making it a tractable surrogate for equilibrium prediction. Third, we develop a mirror descent algorithm to minimize it and demonstrate on a heterogeneous networked Cournot competition that our approach remains accurate under noisy observations and inconsistent equilibrium data while inverse variational inequality methods produce degenerate estimates.

</details>


### [809] [Randomized Online Fair Division: High-Probability and Expected Realized Fairness](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.23577)
*Tianqi Chen,Jingxiao Long*

Main category: cs.GT

TL;DR: 本文研究不可分物品在完全在线场景下的随机分配，提出高概率公平与期望实现公平两种中间公平概念，并对PROP1、EFX、EF1给出相应算法与下界。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 完全在线中物品到达即须立即不可撤销分配且仅知代理人数；精确事前公平易达成但事后无正近似，因此需研究高概率公平与期望实现公平等中间概念。

Method: 针对非自适应对手设计随机算法；以独立均匀分配（Rand）为基线，分析PROP1的高概率与期望实现近似；并证明EFX、EF1的随机在线算法下界。

Result: PROP1：以概率至少1-δ达到Ω(√log n / log(n/δ))近似，期望实现因子Ω(1/√log n)，较Rand提升Ω(√log n)。EFX：任意正因子成功概率可任意小，期望实现因子为0。EF1：任何随机完全在线算法无法以超过(n+1)/(2n)的置信度保证正因子，期望实现保证至多(n+1)/(2n)。

Conclusion: 完全在线随机分配在PROP1上可显著优于均匀随机分配，但EFX与EF1存在强不可能性下界，表明不同公平概念在完全在线模型下可行性差异显著。

Abstract: We study randomized algorithms for the fully online allocation of indivisible goods among $n\ge2$ agents with nonnegative additive valuations. Goods arrive one by one and must be allocated immediately and irrevocably. Nothing is known in advance except the number of agents. Since exact ex-ante envy freeness and proportionality are readily achievable, while no positive ex-post approximation is possible for the fairness notions considered here, we study the intermediate notions of high-probability fairness and expected realized fairness. Against a non-adaptive adversary, we give a randomized algorithm that achieves an $Ω(\sqrt{\log n}/\log(n/δ))$-approximation to proportionality up to one good (PROP1) with probability at least $1-δ$ for every $δ\in(0,1)$, and an expected realized PROP1 factor of $Ω(1/\sqrt{\log n})$. Compared with independent uniform allocation (Rand), these guarantees yield an $Ω(\sqrt{\log n})$ improvement under both the high-probability and expected realized criteria. For envy freeness up to any good (EFX), the success probability of any positive factor can be made arbitrarily small, even for identical valuations. Consequently, the expected realized factor of every randomized fully online algorithm is zero. For envy freeness up to one good (EF1), no randomized fully online algorithm can guarantee a positive factor with confidence exceeding $\frac{n+1}{2n}$. The expected realized EF1 guarantee is also at most $\frac{n+1}{2n}$.

</details>


### [810] [The Geometry of Alliances: Vote Transfer Modelling in French Two-Round Elections](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.23734)
*Emmanuel Omont*

Main category: cs.GT

TL;DR: 该研究基于CHES多维意识形态嵌入构建法国两轮立法选举的选票转移模型，经2017与2022年数据校准后，在2024年三方阵营复杂选区中实现90.34%的选区级预测准确率，揭示意识形态邻近性是选票转移的主因，且一维左右轴不足以刻画相关距离。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 两轮制选举结果不仅取决于首轮得票份额，还取决于首选政党未进入次轮的选民如何在幸存候选人之间重新分配选票。理解这一转移过程对准确预测选举结果至关重要，而简单的一维左右轴可能无法充分捕捉意识形态距离。

Method: 构建基于Chapel Hill Expert Survey多维意识形态嵌入的选票转移模型，以2017年和2022年法国立法选举数据进行校准，并在2024年三方意识形态阵营同时进入次轮的复杂选举中评估模型预测性能。

Result: 模型在2024年选区级预测中达到90.34%的准确率；意识形态邻近性可解释绝大多数选票转移；一维左右轴不足以捕捉相关意识形态距离；2024年选民的结构性配置对极右翼远不如选前预测有利。

Conclusion: 意识形态邻近性是多维框架下主导选民选票转移的核心机制，简单一维模型会低估或误判真实政治距离；2024年法国选举中极右翼的实际结构性劣势被选前预测高估，说明采用多维意识形态模型对精确预测和评估选举竞争格局具有重要意义。

Abstract: Two-round legislative elections are decided not only by first-round vote shares, but by how voters whose preferred party did not advance redistribute their votes among the surviving candidates. We develop a principled model of this transfer process, grounded in multi-dimensional ideological embeddings derived from the Chapel Hill Expert Survey, and apply it to French legislative elections. Calibrated on the 2017 and 2022 elections, the model is evaluated on the unusually complex 2024 contest, in which three ideologically distinct blocs reached the second round simultaneously, achieving 90.34 percent constituency-level accuracy. We show that ideological proximity alone explains the large majority of vote transfers, that a simple left-right axis is insufficient to capture the relevant distances, and that the structural configuration of the 2024 electorate was far less favorable to the far right than pre-election forecasts suggested.

</details>


### [811] [Subgame-Perfect Nash Equilibria of Plurality Voting with Abstention: a PSPACE-Completeness Result for Restricted Ballots](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.24292)
*Edith Elkind*

Main category: cs.GT

TL;DR: 研究带投票成本的序贯Plurality选举中，限制选民只能投排名前缀候选人的变体模型，证明判定指定候选人能否在子博弈完美均衡中获胜是PSPACE完全的，部分解决了Desmedt和Elkind [2010]的开放问题。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 序贯Plurality选举中，选民可能弃权或投给单一候选人，投票有小成本，因此当投票无法改变结果时选民倾向弃权。Desmedt和Elkind [2010]留下开放问题：特定候选人是否能在子博弈完美均衡中成为选举赢家，其计算复杂度尚不明确。

Method: 在模型中，每个选民对候选人赋予效用，导出弱序，平局均匀随机打破。研究的变体额外为每个选民指定其排名的一个前缀，使其只能投票给该前缀内的候选人或弃权。将该情形建模为扩展式博弈，分析其子博弈完美均衡。

Result: 证明在该变体模型下，判定某指定候选人是否属于与扩展式博弈相关的子博弈完美均衡中的选举赢家是PSPACE完全的。

Conclusion: 该结果部分解决了Desmedt和Elkind [2010]提出的开放问题，揭示了序贯Plurality选举均衡判定问题的高计算复杂度。

Abstract: We consider sequential Plurality elections in which each voter may abstain or vote for a single candidate. Each voter assigns utilities to all candidates; for each voter, this induces a (weak) order over the candidates. Ties are resolved uniformly at random, and voting has a small positive cost, so that a voter prefers to abstain when their vote cannot change the election outcome. We consider a variant of this model where, for each voter, we additionally specify a prefix of her ranking, so that she is only allowed to vote for a candidate from that prefix (or abstain). We prove that for this variant of the model, deciding whether a designated candidate is among the election winners in a subgame-perfect equilibrium of the associated extensive-form game is PSPACE-complete. This partially resolves an open problem from the work of Desmedt and Elkind [2010].

</details>


### [812] [Polyhedral Methods for Cooperative Games: Small Lifts and Hard Faces](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.24593)
*Hans Raj Tiwary,Michel Grabisch*

Main category: cs.GT

TL;DR: 研究k-加性合作博弈相关多面体/锥上若干算法问题的计算复杂性，给出正负两方面结果。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 一般合作博弈需2^n输入为平凡问题，限制到k-加性博弈输入降为O(n^k)，但已有Deng-Papadimitriou、Edmonds等可解性结果依赖椭球法，需更高效的显式刻画。

Method: 为k-加性k-单调博弈的核心给出规模O(n^k)的扩展表述；完整刻画k-加性(k-1)-单调博弈锥的极射线并推导相同扩展复杂度界。
